evidence.title: Evaluation of TU-100 (Daikenchuto), a Traditional Japanese Kampo Medicine, as an Adjunct to Enhanced Recovery After Surgery, for Acceleration of Gastrointestinal Recovery After Bowel Resection: Results of a Proof-of-Concept, Phase 2, Randomized, Double-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled Trial.
evidence.venue: Diseases of the colon and rectum
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: TU-100 7.5 g/d was not associated with a statistically significant difference for GI recovery (HR 1.17 [95% CI, 0.91-1.50]).
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: A transient inhibition of GI motility (postoperative ileus) can occur after colorectal surgery and may lead to complications and prolonged hospitalization.
evidence.key_finding: TU-100 7.5 g/d was not associated with a statistically significant difference for GI recovery (HR 1.17 [95% CI, 0.91-1.50]).
evidence.key_finding_ko: TU-100 7.5 g/일은 위장관 회복에서 통계적으로 유의한 차이와 관련되지 않았다(HR 1.17, 95% CI 0.91-1.50).
evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Clinical Trial, Phase II|Randomized Controlled Trial|Multicenter Study
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: A transient inhibition of GI motility (postoperative ileus) can occur after colorectal surgery and may lead to complications and prolonged hospitalization. | INTERVENTIONS: Placebo, TU-100 7.5 g/d, or TU-100 15 g/d given orally from postoperative day 1 for 10 days or less while hospitalized. | However, a higher proportion of patients in the 7.5 g/d group achieved GI recovery by postoperative day 2 versus the placebo group (78.1% vs 66.9%, p = 0.047).

evidence.title: Vitamin D Pretreatment to Prevent the Risk of Postoperative Hypocalcemic Complications After Parathyroidectomy in Primary Hyperparathyroidism: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: Vitamin D supplementation significantly reduced postoperative hypocalcemia (RR: 0.35, 95% CI: 0.18-0.66), symptomatic hypocalcemia (RR: 0.53, 95% CI: 0.29-1.00), and length of stay (MD: -0.51 days, 95% CI: -0.55 to -0.46).
evidence.outcome: CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative vitamin D appears safe and may reduce hypocalcemia-related complications after parathyroidectomy, though current evidence is of low quality.
evidence.key_finding: Vitamin D supplementation significantly reduced postoperative hypocalcemia (RR: 0.35, 95% CI: 0.18-0.66), symptomatic hypocalcemia (RR: 0.53, 95% CI: 0.29-1.00), and length of stay (MD: -0.51 days, 95% CI: -0.55 to -0.46).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 비타민D 보충은 수술 후 저칼슘혈증(RR: 0.35, 95% CI: 0.18-0.66), 증상성 저칼슘혈증(RR: 0.53, 95% CI: 0.29-1.00), 재원 기간(MD: -0.51 일, 95% CI: -0.55 to -0.46)을 유의하게 줄였습니다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Parathyroidectomy is the treatment for primary hyperparathyroidism, yet postoperative hypocalcemia and hungry bone syndrome remain common. | Vitamin D deficiency has been suggested as a modifiable risk factor, but evidence supporting preoperative supplementation is inconsistent. | Vitamin D supplementation significantly reduced postoperative hypocalcemia (RR: 0.35, 95% CI: 0.18-0.66), symptomatic hypocalcemia (RR: 0.53, 95% CI: 0.29-1.00), and length of stay (MD: -0.51 days, 95% CI: -0.55 to -0.46).

evidence.title: Benefits of pre-operative oral Sucrosomial® iron supplementation in cardiac surgery: influence of patient's baseline hemoglobin and gender.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001).
evidence.outcome: Main end-point variables were increase in Hb from randomization to hospital admission, transfusion requirements, and cost-effectiveness of Sucrosomial® iron administration. | RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001). | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 입원 시 철분군과 대조군의 Hb는 각각 0.7 g/dL와 0.1 g/dL 증가했고(p<0.001), 성별 관련 차이는 없었으며, 수혈률(각각 30% 대 59%, p<0.001)과 수혈 지수(각각 0.5 units/patient 대 1.2 units/pt, p<0.001)가 감소했습니다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: The prevalence of low pre-operative hemoglobin (Hb) among cardiac surgery patients is high. | Patients (pt) received a one-month course of 60 mg/day Sucrosomial® iron (Iron group, n=309) or routine care (Control group, n=285) prior to elective cardiac surgery. | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.

all_evidence.title: Effect of probiotics on prognosis in patients with hepatectomy: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trial.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: CONCLUSIONS: Probiotics used perioperatively can lower postoperative infection risk and shorten hospital stays for hepatectomy patients, but they do not appear to aid in liver function restoration or inflammation reduction.
all_evidence.outcome: The results of the meta-analysis revealed that the probiotics group had lower rates of postoperative infectious complications (OR = 0.49; 95%CI 0.49 to 0.60; P < 0.01), serum endotoxin levels (SMD= -0.69; 95%CI -1.27 to -0.11; P = 0.02), white blood cell counts (SMD= -0.37; 95%CI -0.67 to -0.061.47; P = 0.02), hospital stays (SMD= -0.85; 95%CI -1.53 to -0.18; P = 0.01), and first postoperative exhaust times (SMD= -0.85; 95%CI -1.53 to -0.18; P = 0.01) compared to the control group.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Probiotics used perioperatively can lower postoperative infection risk and shorten hospital stays for hepatectomy patients, but they do not appear to aid in liver function restoration or inflammation reduction.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 수술 전후에 사용한 프로바이오틱스는 간 절제술 환자의 수술 후 감염 위험과 재원 기간을 줄일 수 있지만, 간 기능 회복이나 염증 감소에는 도움이 되지 않는 것으로 보입니다.
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the effect of perioperative probiotics on prognosis in patients with hepatectomy. | METHOD: By conducting a computer-based search of electronic databases to collect randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on the use of probiotics in the perioperative period for patients undergoing liver resection. | The results of the meta-analysis revealed that the probiotics group had lower rates of postoperative infectious complications (OR = 0.49; 95%CI 0.49 to 0.60; P < 0.01), serum endotoxin levels (SMD= -0.69; 95%CI -1.27 to -0.11; P = 0.02), white blood cell counts (SMD= -0.37; 95%CI -0.67 to -0.061.47; P = 0.02), hospital stays (SMD= -0.85; 95%CI -1.53 to -0.18; P = 0.01), and first postoperative exhaust times (SMD= -0.85; 95%CI -1.53 to -0.18; P = 0.01) compared to the control group.

all_evidence.title: Value of Probiotics on Outcome in Patients Following Liver Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: Conclusions: The use of pro-/synbiotics during the perioperative period reduces the risk of postoperative infections, support postoperative liver function, and recovery and shortens hospital stays for liver surgery patients.
all_evidence.outcome: The results of the meta-analysis demonstrated that the probiotic group exhibited lower rates of postoperative infectious complications (OR = 0.34; 95%CI 0.25 to 0.45; p < 0.0001), hospital stay duration (SMD = -0.13; 95%CI -0.25 to -0.00; p = 0.05), lower serum endotoxin levels (SMD = -0.39%CI -0.59 to -19; p < 0.0001), and white blood cell counts (SMD = -SMD = -0.35; 95%CI -0.56 to -0.13; p = 0.002) compared to the control group.
all_evidence.key_finding: Conclusions: The use of pro-/synbiotics during the perioperative period reduces the risk of postoperative infections, support postoperative liver function, and recovery and shortens hospital stays for liver surgery patients.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 간 수술 환자에서 수술 전후 프로바이오틱스와 신바이오틱스의 사용은 수술 후 감염 위험을 줄이고, 수술 후 간 기능과 회복을 돕고, 재원 기간을 단축합니다.
all_evidence.population: Background and Objectives: The gut-liver axis plays a crucial role in the development of post-surgical infections. | Surgery-induced dysbiosis can lead to increased bacterial translocation, impairing the liver's detoxification capacity and negatively affecting surgical outcomes. | Following liver surgery, approximately a third of the patients develop bacterial infections, with a high risk of bacteremia or even sepsis-related liver failure and death.

all_evidence.title: Effect of Perioperative Supplementation with Arginine and Omega-3 on Postoperative Complications in Patients Undergoing Gastrointestinal Cancer Surgery: A Pilot Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
all_evidence.outcome: AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | Primary endpoints were postoperative infectious complications and 1-month mortality. | RESULTS: No statistically significant differences were observed between groups in 1-month mortality (p = 0.324), hospital length of stay (median 7 vs. 7 days, p = 0.392), or ICU duration (median 5 vs. 6 days, p = 0.601).
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 이 시험에서 아르기닌과 오메가-3 지방산을 포함한 수술 전후 면역영양은 위장관암 수술 환자의 수술 후 임상결과나 염증표지자를 개선하지 못했다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Perioperative immunonutrition, including arginine and omega-3 fatty acids, has been proposed to support postoperative recovery by modulating immune function. | AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | METHODS: In this Pilot Open-Label randomized trial, 35 adult patients scheduled for elective gastrointestinal cancer surgery at Salah Azaiez Institute were randomly assigned to receive either perioperative immunonutrition (n = 18; three daily capsules of omega-3 and one sachet of Arginine+ for 7 days preoperatively and 7 days postoperatively) or standard care (n = 17).

all_evidence.title: Physical and Nutritional Prehabilitation in Older Patients With Colorectal Carcinoma: A Systematic Review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Sarcopenia and malnourishment are highly prevalent in older patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), who form a growing group of patients at risk of adverse outcome after surgery. | Intervention on physical function and/or nutritional status may decrease the risk of postoperative complications. | None of the preoperative interventions significantly reduced length of stay, mortality, or readmission rates.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 고령 대장암 환자가 수술 전에 운동과 영양 준비를 했을 때 수술 후 합병증이나 입원 기간이 뚜렷하게 줄지는 않았습니다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Sarcopenia and malnourishment are highly prevalent in older patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), who form a growing group of patients at risk of adverse outcome after surgery. | Intervention on physical function and/or nutritional status may decrease the risk of postoperative complications. | However, the overall effect of preoperative physical and nutritional interventions (better known as prehabilitation) in older patients with CRC remains unknown.

all_evidence.title: A systematic review of the cost and cost effectiveness of using standard oral nutritional supplements in the hospital setting.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: Cost savings were typically associated with significantly improved outcomes, demonstrated through the following meta-analyses: reduced mortality (Risk ratio 0.650, P < 0.05; N = 5 studies), reduced complications (by 35% of the total; P < 0.001, N = 7 studies) and reduced length of hospital stay (by ∼2 days, P < 0.05; N = 5 surgical studies) corresponding to ∼13.0% reduction in hospital stay.
all_evidence.outcome: Cost savings were typically associated with significantly improved outcomes, demonstrated through the following meta-analyses: reduced mortality (Risk ratio 0.650, P < 0.05; N = 5 studies), reduced complications (by 35% of the total; P < 0.001, N = 7 studies) and reduced length of hospital stay (by ∼2 days, P < 0.05; N = 5 surgical studies) corresponding to ∼13.0% reduction in hospital stay.
all_evidence.key_finding: Cost savings were typically associated with significantly improved outcomes, demonstrated through the following meta-analyses: reduced mortality (Risk ratio 0.650, P < 0.05; N = 5 studies), reduced complications (by 35% of the total; P < 0.001, N = 7 studies) and reduced length of hospital stay (by ∼2 days, P < 0.05; N = 5 surgical studies) corresponding to ∼13.0% reduction in hospital stay.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 비용 절감은 대체로 유의하게 개선된 결과와 연관됐으며, 메타분석에서 사망률 감소(RR 0.650, P<0.05; 5개 연구), 합병증 35% 감소(P<0.001; 7개 연구), 입원 기간 약 2일 감소(P<0.05; 수술 연구 5개, 입원 기간 약 13% 감소)를 보였습니다.

evidence.title: Effect of Perioperative Supplementation with Arginine and Omega-3 on Postoperative Complications in Patients Undergoing Gastrointestinal Cancer Surgery: A Pilot Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
evidence.outcome: AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | Primary endpoints were postoperative infectious complications and 1-month mortality. | RESULTS: No statistically significant differences were observed between groups in 1-month mortality (p = 0.324), hospital length of stay (median 7 vs. 7 days, p = 0.392), or ICU duration (median 5 vs. 6 days, p = 0.601).
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이 시험에서 아르기닌과 오메가-3 지방산을 포함한 수술 전후 면역영양은 위장관암 수술 환자의 수술 후 임상결과나 염증표지자를 개선하지 못했다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Perioperative immunonutrition, including arginine and omega-3 fatty acids, has been proposed to support postoperative recovery by modulating immune function. | AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | METHODS: In this Pilot Open-Label randomized trial, 35 adult patients scheduled for elective gastrointestinal cancer surgery at Salah Azaiez Institute were randomly assigned to receive either perioperative immunonutrition (n = 18; three daily capsules of omega-3 and one sachet of Arginine+ for 7 days preoperatively and 7 days postoperatively) or standard care (n = 17).

evidence.title: Physical and Nutritional Prehabilitation in Older Patients With Colorectal Carcinoma: A Systematic Review.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Sarcopenia and malnourishment are highly prevalent in older patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), who form a growing group of patients at risk of adverse outcome after surgery. | Intervention on physical function and/or nutritional status may decrease the risk of postoperative complications. | None of the preoperative interventions significantly reduced length of stay, mortality, or readmission rates.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 고령 대장암 환자가 수술 전에 운동과 영양 준비를 했을 때 수술 후 합병증이나 입원 기간이 뚜렷하게 줄지는 않았습니다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Sarcopenia and malnourishment are highly prevalent in older patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), who form a growing group of patients at risk of adverse outcome after surgery. | Intervention on physical function and/or nutritional status may decrease the risk of postoperative complications. | However, the overall effect of preoperative physical and nutritional interventions (better known as prehabilitation) in older patients with CRC remains unknown.

evidence.title: Evaluation of TU-100 (Daikenchuto), a Traditional Japanese Kampo Medicine, as an Adjunct to Enhanced Recovery After Surgery, for Acceleration of Gastrointestinal Recovery After Bowel Resection: Results of a Proof-of-Concept, Phase 2, Randomized, Double-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled Trial.
evidence.venue: Diseases of the colon and rectum
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: TU-100 7.5 g/d was not associated with a statistically significant difference for GI recovery (HR 1.17 [95% CI, 0.91-1.50]).
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: A transient inhibition of GI motility (postoperative ileus) can occur after colorectal surgery and may lead to complications and prolonged hospitalization.
evidence.key_finding: TU-100 7.5 g/d was not associated with a statistically significant difference for GI recovery (HR 1.17 [95% CI, 0.91-1.50]).
evidence.key_finding_ko: TU-100 7.5 g/일은 위장관 회복에서 통계적으로 유의한 차이와 관련되지 않았다(HR 1.17, 95% CI 0.91-1.50).
evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Clinical Trial, Phase II|Randomized Controlled Trial|Multicenter Study
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: A transient inhibition of GI motility (postoperative ileus) can occur after colorectal surgery and may lead to complications and prolonged hospitalization. | INTERVENTIONS: Placebo, TU-100 7.5 g/d, or TU-100 15 g/d given orally from postoperative day 1 for 10 days or less while hospitalized. | However, a higher proportion of patients in the 7.5 g/d group achieved GI recovery by postoperative day 2 versus the placebo group (78.1% vs 66.9%, p = 0.047).

evidence.title: Benefits of pre-operative oral Sucrosomial® iron supplementation in cardiac surgery: influence of patient's baseline hemoglobin and gender.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001).
evidence.outcome: Main end-point variables were increase in Hb from randomization to hospital admission, transfusion requirements, and cost-effectiveness of Sucrosomial® iron administration. | RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001). | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 입원 시 철분군과 대조군의 Hb는 각각 0.7 g/dL와 0.1 g/dL 증가했고(p<0.001), 성별 관련 차이는 없었으며, 수혈률(각각 30% 대 59%, p<0.001)과 수혈 지수(각각 0.5 units/patient 대 1.2 units/pt, p<0.001)가 감소했습니다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: The prevalence of low pre-operative hemoglobin (Hb) among cardiac surgery patients is high. | Patients (pt) received a one-month course of 60 mg/day Sucrosomial® iron (Iron group, n=309) or routine care (Control group, n=285) prior to elective cardiac surgery. | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.

evidence.outcome: Main end-point variables were increase in Hb from randomization to hospital admission, transfusion requirements, and cost-effectiveness of Sucrosomial® iron administration. | RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001). | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: At hospital admission, Hb had increased 0.7 g/dL and 0.1 g/dL, for Iron and Control groups, respectively (p<0.001), with no gender-related differences, leading to a decrease in transfusion rate (30 vs 59%, respectively; p<0.001) and transfusion index (0.5 units/patient vs 1.2 units/pt, respectively; p<0.001).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 입원 시 철분군과 대조군의 Hb는 각각 0.7 g/dL와 0.1 g/dL 증가했고(p<0.001), 성별 관련 차이는 없었으며, 수혈률(각각 30% 대 59%, p<0.001)과 수혈 지수(각각 0.5 units/patient 대 1.2 units/pt, p<0.001)가 감소했습니다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: The prevalence of low pre-operative hemoglobin (Hb) among cardiac surgery patients is high. | Patients (pt) received a one-month course of 60 mg/day Sucrosomial® iron (Iron group, n=309) or routine care (Control group, n=285) prior to elective cardiac surgery. | CONCLUSIONS: This post-hoc analysis confirms pre-operative Sucrosomial® iron administration is a safe and cost-effective strategy to increase preoperative Hb and decrease transfusion requirements in elective cardiac surgery, especially in those anemic at baseline.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_14: Supportive psychotherapy in "low-functioning" patients, (home) rehabilitation programmes and nutritional supplementation appeared to have beneficial effects on HS.
all_evidence.outcome: Mental state, prefracture functioning on physical and psychosocial domains, comorbidity, female gender, nutritional status, postoperative pain, length of hospital stay, and complications were factors associated with HS or HRQOL.
all_evidence.key_finding: Supportive psychotherapy in "low-functioning" patients, (home) rehabilitation programmes and nutritional supplementation appeared to have beneficial effects on HS.

all_evidence.population: Mental state, prefracture functioning on physical and psychosocial domains, comorbidity, female gender, nutritional status, postoperative pain, length of hospital stay, and complications were factors associated with HS or HRQOL. | CONCLUSIONS: Optimizing nutrition intake, (home) rehabilitation programmes, and the possibility for psychological counselling in patients with difficulties in the psychosocial dimensions would be recommended after hip fracture surgery. | Besides HS questionnaires like EQ-5D and SF-36, adequate measurements like the WHOQOL-Bref or ICECAP-O are warranted in future studies regarding hip fracture surgery and postoperative treatment options.

evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: Nutrition alone resulted in significant weight retention (2.60; 2.32, 2.88, p < 0.00001), length of stay (-4.00; -6.87, -1.13), p = 0.0006) and complications (0.64; 0.49, 0.83, p = 0.0009).
evidence.outcome: Quality of life, length of hospital stay, postoperative complications, change in body mass index or muscle mass, and functional assessments were the primary outcomes. | Nutrition alone resulted in significant weight retention (2.60; 2.32, 2.88, p < 0.00001), length of stay (-4.00; -6.87, -1.13), p = 0.0006) and complications (0.64; 0.49, 0.83, p = 0.0009). | Nutrition and psychoeducation resulted in a significant reduction in mortality rate (0.70; 0.49, 1.00, p = 0.05 and 0.60; 0.48, 0.74, p < 0.00001), and exercise resulted in a significant reduction in dysphagia (0.55; 0.35, 0.87, p = 0.01).

evidence.title: Effect of Perioperative Supplementation with Arginine and Omega-3 on Postoperative Complications in Patients Undergoing Gastrointestinal Cancer Surgery: A Pilot Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
evidence.outcome: AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | Primary endpoints were postoperative infectious complications and 1-month mortality. | RESULTS: No statistically significant differences were observed between groups in 1-month mortality (p = 0.324), hospital length of stay (median 7 vs. 7 days, p = 0.392), or ICU duration (median 5 vs. 6 days, p = 0.601).
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이 시험에서 아르기닌과 오메가-3 지방산을 포함한 수술 전후 면역영양은 위장관암 수술 환자의 수술 후 임상결과나 염증표지자를 개선하지 못했다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Perioperative immunonutrition, including arginine and omega-3 fatty acids, has been proposed to support postoperative recovery by modulating immune function. | AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | METHODS: In this Pilot Open-Label randomized trial, 35 adult patients scheduled for elective gastrointestinal cancer surgery at Salah Azaiez Institute were randomly assigned to receive either perioperative immunonutrition (n = 18; three daily capsules of omega-3 and one sachet of Arginine+ for 7 days preoperatively and 7 days postoperatively) or standard care (n = 17).

evidence.title: Physical and Nutritional Prehabilitation in Older Patients With Colorectal Carcinoma: A Systematic Review.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Sarcopenia and malnourishment are highly prevalent in older patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), who form a growing group of patients at risk of adverse outcome after surgery. | Intervention on physical function and/or nutritional status may decrease the risk of postoperative complications. | None of the preoperative interventions significantly reduced length of stay, mortality, or readmission rates.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 고령 대장암 환자가 수술 전에 운동과 영양 준비를 했을 때 수술 후 합병증이나 입원 기간이 뚜렷하게 줄지는 않았습니다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Sarcopenia and malnourishment are highly prevalent in older patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), who form a growing group of patients at risk of adverse outcome after surgery. | Intervention on physical function and/or nutritional status may decrease the risk of postoperative complications. | However, the overall effect of preoperative physical and nutritional interventions (better known as prehabilitation) in older patients with CRC remains unknown.

evidence.title: Chinese herbal medicine (Tangshen Formula) formula treatment of patients with diabetic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).
evidence.outcome: The main outcome indicators included renal Primary Outcomes(UAER, 24h UP), Secondary Outcomes(eGFR and TCM system scores) and adverse events. | In the TMC compound therapy for DKD patients with massive proteinuria, the results show that the probability of adverse experiments in the intervention group was significantly lower than that in the control group (OR= 0.55 95% CI 0.30-1.03), P=0.79).
evidence.key_finding: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).

evidence.population: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE: Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD) is a severe complication of diabetes mellitus and is one of the main causes of end-stage renal disease globally. | The main outcome indicators included renal Primary Outcomes(UAER, 24h UP), Secondary Outcomes(eGFR and TCM system scores) and adverse events.

evidence.title: Meta-analysis of Niaoduqing Granules for uremic pruritus in Chinese hemodialysis patients: efficacy and safety evidence from RCTs.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Uremic pruritus, a common complication in hemodialysis populations, adversely affects quality of life owing to multifactorial etiology. | This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%). | CONCLUSION: Niaoduqing Granules demonstrated efficacy in reducing pruritus severity among hemodialysis patients without increasing drug-related adverse events, while also showing concomitant reductions in inflammatory biomarkers.
evidence.key_finding: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).

all_evidence.title: Protein-bound uremic toxin lowering strategies in chronic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: When compared with placebo, prebiotics, synbiotics, and AST-120 provided significantly lower levels of both serum indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate.
all_evidence.outcome: INTRODUCTION: Accumulation of protein-bound uremic toxins, including indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate, are associated with increased cardiovascular disease and mortality in chronic kidney disease (CKD).
all_evidence.key_finding: When compared with placebo, prebiotics, synbiotics, and AST-120 provided significantly lower levels of both serum indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 위약과 비교했을 때 프리바이오틱스, 신바이오틱스, AST-120은 혈청 인독실황산과 p-크레실황산 수치를 모두 유의하게 낮췄습니다.
all_evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Accumulation of protein-bound uremic toxins, including indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate, are associated with increased cardiovascular disease and mortality in chronic kidney disease (CKD). | We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis to synthesize the available strategies for lowering protein-bound uremic toxin levels in CKD patients. | METHODS: We conducted a meta-analysis by searching the databases of MEDLINE, Scopus, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials for observational studies and randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that examined the effect of dietary protein restrictions, biotic supplements (including prebiotics, probiotics, and synbiotics), AST-120, dialysis techniques, and the outcome of preservation of residual renal function (RRF) on indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate levels.

all_evidence.title: Vitamin Profile of the Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease Receiving a Novel Total Parenteral Nutrition Formula: Multicenter Randomized Controlled Phase III Trial.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: RESULTS: Values of blood protein until day 8 were similar in 2 groups although those of vitamins B1, B6, C, and folic acid (contained more in OPF-109) were higher in the OPF-109 group.
all_evidence.outcome: Safety endpoints were hematological data, blood biochemistry data, vital signs, and adverse events.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Values of blood protein until day 8 were similar in 2 groups although those of vitamins B1, B6, C, and folic acid (contained more in OPF-109) were higher in the OPF-109 group.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 8일까지 혈중 단백질 수치는 두 군이 비슷했지만, 비타민 B1·B6·C와 엽산 수치는 OPF-109군에서 더 높았다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Clinical Trial, Phase III|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial
all_evidence.population:
UNLABELLED:

Introduction: Efficacy and safety of a novel total parenteral nutrition formula for chronic kidney disease patients, OPF-109, containing multivitamins based on the FDA2000 recommendation were investigated. | METHODS: We conducted a phase III clinical trial administering OPF-109 (n = 63) or the control solutions (combination of marketed products including multivitamin based on American Medical Association 1975 guidelines) (n = 61) to the chronic kidney disease patients for 8 days. | CONCLUSION: Efficacy and safety of OPF-109 and usefulness of multivitamins based on the FDA2000 recommendation formula were confirmed in chronic kidney disease patients.

all_evidence.title: Effect of vitamin K1 supplementation on coronary calcifications in hemodialysis patients: a randomized controlled trial.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | The severity of arterial calcifications predicts the risk of coronary heart disease and increases the risk of premature cardiovascular death.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 연구에 등록된 멕시코 혈액투석 코호트에서 정맥 비타민K1 보충은 12개월 추적 기간 동안 위약과 비교해 관상동맥 석회화 진행을 55% 줄였습니다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | METHODS: In this single-center clinical trial (NCT04247087 on 07/09/2019), we randomized 60 Mexican patients on chronic hemodialysis and a coronary calcification score > 10 Agatston units to receive 10 mg intravenous vitamin K1 or placebo at the end of the hemodialysis session thrice weekly for 12 months. | CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.

all_evidence.title: [Meta-analysis of Bailing Capsules in improvement of microinflammation and nutritional status among maintenance hemodialysis patients].
all_evidence.venue: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: In conclusion, Bailing Capsules might have potential advantages in alleviating microinflammation, improving nutritional status, and reducing the incidence of cardiovascular events.
all_evidence.outcome: As revealed by Meta-analysis,(1)Bailing Capsules lowered the levels of serum high sensitivity C-reactive protein(SMD=-0.92, 95%CI[-1.05,-0.80], P<0.000 01), interleukin-6(SMD=-1.49, 95%CI[-1.96,-1.02], P<0.000 01), and tumor necrosis factor-α(SMD=-1.48, 95%CI[-1.68,-1.28], P<0.000 01) in patients with maintenance hemodialysis, thus alleviating microinflammation.(2)Bailing Capsules elevated the levels of serum hemoglobin(SMD=1.37, 95%CI[1.21, 1.54], P<0.000 01), albumin(SMD=0.78, 95%CI[0.57, 0.98], P<0.000 01), and triglyceride(SMD=0.29, 95%CI[0.07, 0.50], P=0.01) in patients with hemodialysis to improve their nutritional status.(3)Bailing Capsules reduced the incidence of cardiovascular events(RR=0.45, 95%CI[0.34, 0.59], P<0.000 01).(4)A total of six patients presented with mild gastrointestinal discomfort after receiving Bailing Capsules, and no serious adverse reactions were observed. | In conclusion, Bailing Capsules might have potential advantages in alleviating microinflammation, improving nutritional status, and reducing the incidence of cardiovascular events.
all_evidence.key_finding: In conclusion, Bailing Capsules might have potential advantages in alleviating microinflammation, improving nutritional status, and reducing the incidence of cardiovascular events.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론적으로 바이링 캡슐은 미세염증 완화, 영양 상태 개선, 심혈관 사건 발생률 감소에 잠재적 이점이 있을 수 있습니다.
all_evidence.population: This Meta-analysis was designed to evaluate the effects of Bailing Capsules on microinflammation and nutritional status of maintenance hemodialysis patients, and to determine its efficacy and safety. | The randomized controlled trials concerning the intervention of microinflammation and nutritional status in maintenance hemodialysis patients with Bailing Capsules were searched from Chinese and English databases including CNKI, Wanfang, VIP, PubMed, EMbase, and Cochrane Library. | As revealed by Meta-analysis,(1)Bailing Capsules lowered the levels of serum high sensitivity C-reactive protein(SMD=-0.92, 95%CI[-1.05,-0.80], P<0.000 01), interleukin-6(SMD=-1.49, 95%CI[-1.96,-1.02], P<0.000 01), and tumor necrosis factor-α(SMD=-1.48, 95%CI[-1.68,-1.28], P<0.000 01) in patients with maintenance hemodialysis, thus alleviating microinflammation.(2)Bailing Capsules elevated the levels of serum hemoglobin(SMD=1.37, 95%CI[1.21, 1.54], P<0.000 01), albumin(SMD=0.78, 95%CI[0.57, 0.98], P<0.000 01), and triglyceride(SMD=0.29, 95%CI[0.07, 0.50], P=0.01) in patients with hemodialysis to improve their nutritional status.(3)Bailing Capsules reduced the incidence of cardiovascular events(RR=0.45, 95%CI[0.34, 0.59], P<0.000 01).(4)A total of six patients presented with mild gastrointestinal discomfort after receiving Bailing Capsules, and no serious adverse reactions were observed.

all_evidence.title: Ferric pyrophosphate citrate (Triferic™) administration via the dialysate maintains hemoglobin and iron balance in chronic hemodialysis patients.
all_evidence.venue: Nephrology, dialysis, transplantation : official publication of the European Dialysis and Transplant Association - European Renal Association
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: In both trials, Hgb concentration was maintained from baseline to EoT in the FPC group but decreased by 0.4 g/dL in the placebo group (P < 0.001, combined results; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.2-0.6).
all_evidence.outcome: The proportions of patients with adverse and serious adverse events were similar in both treatment groups.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: In both trials, Hgb concentration was maintained from baseline to EoT in the FPC group but decreased by 0.4 g/dL in the placebo group (P < 0.001, combined results; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.2-0.6).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 두 연구 모두 FPC군의 Hgb 농도는 기저치부터 연구 종료 시점까지 유지됐지만 위약군에서는 0.4 g/dL 감소했습니다(P<0.001; 통합 결과 95% 신뢰구간 0.2~0.6).
all_evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Administration of ferric pyrophosphate citrate (FPC, Triferic™) via hemodialysate may allow replacement of ongoing uremic and hemodialysis-related iron losses. | METHODS: Two identical Phase 3, randomized, placebo-controlled trials (CRUISE 1 and 2) were conducted in 599 iron-replete chronic hemodialysis patients. | CONCLUSIONS: FPC delivered via dialysate during hemodialysis replaces iron losses, maintains Hgb concentrations, does not increase iron stores and exhibits a safety profile similar to placebo.

all_evidence.title: Inflammation-Driven Differential Response to Intravenous versus Oral Iron Supplementation in Hemodialysis Patients: A post hoc Analysis of the IHOPE Trial.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: Patients with elevated hsCRP showed poorer hemoglobin responses to intravenous iron sucrose, while oral polysaccharide-iron complex maintained consistent efficacy across inflammatory states.
all_evidence.outcome: Iron parameters and adverse events were comparable across groups.
all_evidence.key_finding: Patients with elevated hsCRP showed poorer hemoglobin responses to intravenous iron sucrose, while oral polysaccharide-iron complex maintained consistent efficacy across inflammatory states.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: hsCRP가 상승한 환자는 정맥 철 sucrose에 대한 혈색소 반응이 더 나빴지만, 경구 다당류 철 복합체는 염증 상태 전반에서 일관된 효능을 유지했습니다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Comparative Study|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Anemia is common in hemodialysis patients, and iron supplementation is essential for its management. | METHODS: This post hoc analysis of the IHOPE trial included 193 maintenance hemodialysis patients stratified by median baseline high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP). | CONCLUSION: This post hoc analysis suggests baseline inflammation significantly modifies responses to specific iron formulations in hemodialysis patients.

all_evidence.title: Randomized trial of two maintenance doses of vitamin D in children with chronic kidney disease.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: In children with CKD stages 3-5, a dose of vitamin D3 4000 IU daily was effective in achieving or maintaining vitamin D sufficiency.
all_evidence.outcome: None of the patients developed vitamin D toxicity or hypercalcemia.
all_evidence.key_finding: In children with CKD stages 3-5, a dose of vitamin D3 4000 IU daily was effective in achieving or maintaining vitamin D sufficiency.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 만성콩팥병 3단계에서 5단계 소아에서 비타민D3 4000 IU를 매일 투여하는 것은 비타민D 충분 상태를 달성하거나 유지하는 데 효과적이었습니다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Correction of nutritional vitamin deficiency is recommended in children with chronic kidney disease (CKD). | METHODS: We conducted a phase III, double-blind, randomized trial of two doses of vitamin D3 in children ≥ 9 years of age with CKD stages 3-5 or kidney transplant recipients. | CONCLUSIONS: In children with CKD, 1000 IU of daily vitamin D3 is unlikely to achieve or maintain a plasma 25(OH)D ≥ 30 ng/mL.

all_evidence.title: The role of nutritional vitamin D on microinflammation and nutritional status in maintenance hemodialysis patients: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
all_evidence.outcome: Key outcomes included CRP, serum albumin, TNF-α, IL-1β, immunoreactive Parathyroid Hormone (iPTH), adverse events, hypercalcemia, and hyperphosphatemia. | In terms of safety, the overall incidence of adverse reactions in the nutritional vitamin D group was similar to that in the control group (P = 0.09). | Moreover, no significant differences were found in the incidence of hypercalcemia and hyperphosphatemia between the two groups (P = 0.15, P = 0.32).
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 영양학적 비타민 D 보충은 혈액투석 환자의 미세염증과 영양상태를 개선할 수 있고, 고칼슘혈증이나 고인산혈증 위험을 뚜렷하게 높이지 않으면서 뼈 대사에도 이득이 있을 수 있다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Microinflammation is widespread in Maintenance hemodialysis (MHD) patients. | Nutritional vitamin D deficiency is closely related to chronic kidney disease inflammation, but whether correcting this deficiency can improve microinflammation in the MHD population remains unclear.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of pharmacological treatments for restless legs syndrome in hemodialysis patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_20: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
all_evidence.outcome: The primary outcome was change in International Restless Legs Scale (IRLS) scores; secondary outcomes included sleep quality, quality of life, dialysis adequacy, and adverse events. | Adverse events increased modestly (RR 1.28), highest with dopaminergic agents. | A heatmap further revealed that dopaminergic agents were associated with the highest frequency of adverse events, particularly nausea, hypotension, and augmentation.
all_evidence.key_finding: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 도파민 작용제는 유익하지만 이상반응 위험이 더 높다는 제한이 있고, 철분 치료는 내약성이 양호하면서 중등도 이득을 보였다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS) is highly prevalent among adults receiving maintenance hemodialysis and significantly impairs sleep, psychological well-being, and quality of life. | While Western pharmacological treatments such as dopaminergic agents, gabapentinoids, and iron therapy are commonly studied, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is also widely used in clinical practice-particularly for syndromes corresponding to RLS such as blood deficiency (Xue Xu), liver-kidney yin deficiency (Gan Shen Bu Zu), and blood stasis (Xue Yu). | However, the evidence base for TCM pharmacologic interventions in hemodialysis-related RLS remains unclear.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and Safety of Ferric Citrate on Hyperphosphatemia among Chinese Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease Undergoing Hemodialysis: A Phase III Multicenter Randomized Open-Label Active-Drug-Controlled Study.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
all_evidence.outcome: INTRODUCTION: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients is positively associated with mortality. | Frequency and severity of adverse events were recorded. | There are 47 (40.5%) patients in the ferric citrate group, and 26 (21.3%) patients in the sevelamer carbonate group experienced drug-related treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs); most were mild and tolerable.
all_evidence.key_finding: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.

evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of pharmacological treatments for restless legs syndrome in hemodialysis patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_20: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
evidence.outcome: The primary outcome was change in International Restless Legs Scale (IRLS) scores; secondary outcomes included sleep quality, quality of life, dialysis adequacy, and adverse events. | Adverse events increased modestly (RR 1.28), highest with dopaminergic agents. | A heatmap further revealed that dopaminergic agents were associated with the highest frequency of adverse events, particularly nausea, hypotension, and augmentation.
evidence.key_finding: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.

evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS) is highly prevalent among adults receiving maintenance hemodialysis and significantly impairs sleep, psychological well-being, and quality of life. | While Western pharmacological treatments such as dopaminergic agents, gabapentinoids, and iron therapy are commonly studied, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is also widely used in clinical practice-particularly for syndromes corresponding to RLS such as blood deficiency (Xue Xu), liver-kidney yin deficiency (Gan Shen Bu Zu), and blood stasis (Xue Yu). | However, the evidence base for TCM pharmacologic interventions in hemodialysis-related RLS remains unclear.

evidence.title: Effect of vitamin K1 supplementation on coronary calcifications in hemodialysis patients: a randomized controlled trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | The severity of arterial calcifications predicts the risk of coronary heart disease and increases the risk of premature cardiovascular death.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 연구에 등록된 멕시코 혈액투석 코호트에서 정맥 비타민K1 보충은 12개월 추적 기간 동안 위약과 비교해 관상동맥 석회화 진행을 55% 줄였습니다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | METHODS: In this single-center clinical trial (NCT04247087 on 07/09/2019), we randomized 60 Mexican patients on chronic hemodialysis and a coronary calcification score > 10 Agatston units to receive 10 mg intravenous vitamin K1 or placebo at the end of the hemodialysis session thrice weekly for 12 months. | CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.

evidence.title: Inflammation-Driven Differential Response to Intravenous versus Oral Iron Supplementation in Hemodialysis Patients: A post hoc Analysis of the IHOPE Trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: Patients with elevated hsCRP showed poorer hemoglobin responses to intravenous iron sucrose, while oral polysaccharide-iron complex maintained consistent efficacy across inflammatory states.
evidence.outcome: Iron parameters and adverse events were comparable across groups.
evidence.key_finding: Patients with elevated hsCRP showed poorer hemoglobin responses to intravenous iron sucrose, while oral polysaccharide-iron complex maintained consistent efficacy across inflammatory states.
evidence.key_finding_ko: hsCRP가 상승한 환자는 정맥 철 sucrose에 대한 혈색소 반응이 더 나빴지만, 경구 다당류 철 복합체는 염증 상태 전반에서 일관된 효능을 유지했습니다.
evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Comparative Study|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Anemia is common in hemodialysis patients, and iron supplementation is essential for its management. | METHODS: This post hoc analysis of the IHOPE trial included 193 maintenance hemodialysis patients stratified by median baseline high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP). | CONCLUSION: This post hoc analysis suggests baseline inflammation significantly modifies responses to specific iron formulations in hemodialysis patients.

evidence.title: Chinese herbal medicine (Tangshen Formula) formula treatment of patients with diabetic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).
evidence.outcome: The main outcome indicators included renal Primary Outcomes(UAER, 24h UP), Secondary Outcomes(eGFR and TCM system scores) and adverse events. | In the TMC compound therapy for DKD patients with massive proteinuria, the results show that the probability of adverse experiments in the intervention group was significantly lower than that in the control group (OR= 0.55 95% CI 0.30-1.03), P=0.79).
evidence.key_finding: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).

evidence.title: Meta-analysis of Niaoduqing Granules for uremic pruritus in Chinese hemodialysis patients: efficacy and safety evidence from RCTs.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Uremic pruritus, a common complication in hemodialysis populations, adversely affects quality of life owing to multifactorial etiology. | This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%). | CONCLUSION: Niaoduqing Granules demonstrated efficacy in reducing pruritus severity among hemodialysis patients without increasing drug-related adverse events, while also showing concomitant reductions in inflammatory biomarkers.
evidence.key_finding: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이 메타분석에서는 니아오두칭 과립군의 임상적으로 의미 있는 효과가 우세했습니다(RR=1.249, 95% CI 1.169~1.335, p<0.001). 3개 시험의 안전성 분석에서는 이상반응률이 비슷했습니다(R=1.303, 95% CI 0.589~2.884, p=0.514; I²=0.0%).
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Uremic pruritus, a common complication in hemodialysis populations, adversely affects quality of life owing to multifactorial etiology. | To assess its therapeutic potential, a retrospective meta-analysis was performed to evaluate efficacy and safety profiles in hemodialysis cohorts. | We systematically reviewed all available randomized controlled trials (RCTs) investigating the effects of Niaoduqing Granules on uremic pruritus in hemodialysis populations.

evidence.title: Role of omega-3 fatty acids in reducing proteinuria: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.venue: Asia Pacific journal of clinical nutrition
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: RESULTS: The meta-analysis revealed a neutral overall effect size of omega-3 fatty acid supplementation on proteinuria levels, assessed under both common and random effect models.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Proteinuria, a hallmark of renal and systemic disorders, is associated with adverse outcomes, especially in chronic kidney disease and cardiovascular disease. | Omega-3 fatty acids have garnered attention for their cardiovascular benefits and potential therapeutic effects on proteinuria.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: The meta-analysis revealed a neutral overall effect size of omega-3 fatty acid supplementation on proteinuria levels, assessed under both common and random effect models.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 메타분석에서 고정효과 모형과 무작위효과 모형 모두 오메가3 지방산 보충이 단백뇨 수치에 미치는 전체 효과 크기는 중립적이었습니다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Proteinuria, a hallmark of renal and systemic disorders, is associated with adverse outcomes, especially in chronic kidney disease and cardiovascular disease. | This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the impact of omega-3 fatty acid supplementation on proteinuria levels across various kidney-related conditions. | These findings contribute to the evolving understanding of personalized kidney health strategies and pave the way for further exploration and optimization of omega-3 fatty acids' therapeutic applications.

all_evidence.title: Protein-bound uremic toxin lowering strategies in chronic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: When compared with placebo, prebiotics, synbiotics, and AST-120 provided significantly lower levels of both serum indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate.
all_evidence.outcome: INTRODUCTION: Accumulation of protein-bound uremic toxins, including indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate, are associated with increased cardiovascular disease and mortality in chronic kidney disease (CKD).
all_evidence.key_finding: When compared with placebo, prebiotics, synbiotics, and AST-120 provided significantly lower levels of both serum indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 위약과 비교했을 때 프리바이오틱스, 신바이오틱스, AST-120은 혈청 인독실황산과 p-크레실황산 수치를 모두 유의하게 낮췄습니다.
all_evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Accumulation of protein-bound uremic toxins, including indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate, are associated with increased cardiovascular disease and mortality in chronic kidney disease (CKD). | We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis to synthesize the available strategies for lowering protein-bound uremic toxin levels in CKD patients. | METHODS: We conducted a meta-analysis by searching the databases of MEDLINE, Scopus, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials for observational studies and randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that examined the effect of dietary protein restrictions, biotic supplements (including prebiotics, probiotics, and synbiotics), AST-120, dialysis techniques, and the outcome of preservation of residual renal function (RRF) on indoxyl sulfate and p-cresyl sulfate levels.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: RESULTS: Values of blood protein until day 8 were similar in 2 groups although those of vitamins B1, B6, C, and folic acid (contained more in OPF-109) were higher in the OPF-109 group.
all_evidence.outcome: Safety endpoints were hematological data, blood biochemistry data, vital signs, and adverse events.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Values of blood protein until day 8 were similar in 2 groups although those of vitamins B1, B6, C, and folic acid (contained more in OPF-109) were higher in the OPF-109 group.

all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Clinical Trial, Phase III|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial
all_evidence.population:
UNLABELLED:

Introduction: Efficacy and safety of a novel total parenteral nutrition formula for chronic kidney disease patients, OPF-109, containing multivitamins based on the FDA2000 recommendation were investigated. | METHODS: We conducted a phase III clinical trial administering OPF-109 (n = 63) or the control solutions (combination of marketed products including multivitamin based on American Medical Association 1975 guidelines) (n = 61) to the chronic kidney disease patients for 8 days. | CONCLUSION: Efficacy and safety of OPF-109 and usefulness of multivitamins based on the FDA2000 recommendation formula were confirmed in chronic kidney disease patients.

all_evidence.title: Effect of vitamin K1 supplementation on coronary calcifications in hemodialysis patients: a randomized controlled trial.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | The severity of arterial calcifications predicts the risk of coronary heart disease and increases the risk of premature cardiovascular death.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 연구에 등록된 멕시코 혈액투석 코호트에서 정맥 비타민K1 보충은 12개월 추적 기간 동안 위약과 비교해 관상동맥 석회화 진행을 55% 줄였습니다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with several adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including coronary heart disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias. | METHODS: In this single-center clinical trial (NCT04247087 on 07/09/2019), we randomized 60 Mexican patients on chronic hemodialysis and a coronary calcification score > 10 Agatston units to receive 10 mg intravenous vitamin K1 or placebo at the end of the hemodialysis session thrice weekly for 12 months. | CONCLUSIONS: In the Mexican hemodialysis cohort enrolled in this study intravenous vitamin K1 supplementation reduced the progression of coronary artery calcifications by 55% compared with placebo over a 12-month follow-up period.

all_evidence.title: [Meta-analysis of Bailing Capsules in improvement of microinflammation and nutritional status among maintenance hemodialysis patients].
all_evidence.venue: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: In conclusion, Bailing Capsules might have potential advantages in alleviating microinflammation, improving nutritional status, and reducing the incidence of cardiovascular events.
all_evidence.outcome: As revealed by Meta-analysis,(1)Bailing Capsules lowered the levels of serum high sensitivity C-reactive protein(SMD=-0.92, 95%CI[-1.05,-0.80], P<0.000 01), interleukin-6(SMD=-1.49, 95%CI[-1.96,-1.02], P<0.000 01), and tumor necrosis factor-α(SMD=-1.48, 95%CI[-1.68,-1.28], P<0.000 01) in patients with maintenance hemodialysis, thus alleviating microinflammation.(2)Bailing Capsules elevated the levels of serum hemoglobin(SMD=1.37, 95%CI[1.21, 1.54], P<0.000 01), albumin(SMD=0.78, 95%CI[0.57, 0.98], P<0.000 01), and triglyceride(SMD=0.29, 95%CI[0.07, 0.50], P=0.01) in patients with hemodialysis to improve their nutritional status.(3)Bailing Capsules reduced the incidence of cardiovascular events(RR=0.45, 95%CI[0.34, 0.59], P<0.000 01).(4)A total of six patients presented with mild gastrointestinal discomfort after receiving Bailing Capsules, and no serious adverse reactions were observed. | In conclusion, Bailing Capsules might have potential advantages in alleviating microinflammation, improving nutritional status, and reducing the incidence of cardiovascular events.
all_evidence.key_finding: In conclusion, Bailing Capsules might have potential advantages in alleviating microinflammation, improving nutritional status, and reducing the incidence of cardiovascular events.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론적으로 바이링 캡슐은 미세염증 완화, 영양 상태 개선, 심혈관 사건 발생률 감소에 잠재적 이점이 있을 수 있습니다.
all_evidence.population: This Meta-analysis was designed to evaluate the effects of Bailing Capsules on microinflammation and nutritional status of maintenance hemodialysis patients, and to determine its efficacy and safety. | The randomized controlled trials concerning the intervention of microinflammation and nutritional status in maintenance hemodialysis patients with Bailing Capsules were searched from Chinese and English databases including CNKI, Wanfang, VIP, PubMed, EMbase, and Cochrane Library. | As revealed by Meta-analysis,(1)Bailing Capsules lowered the levels of serum high sensitivity C-reactive protein(SMD=-0.92, 95%CI[-1.05,-0.80], P<0.000 01), interleukin-6(SMD=-1.49, 95%CI[-1.96,-1.02], P<0.000 01), and tumor necrosis factor-α(SMD=-1.48, 95%CI[-1.68,-1.28], P<0.000 01) in patients with maintenance hemodialysis, thus alleviating microinflammation.(2)Bailing Capsules elevated the levels of serum hemoglobin(SMD=1.37, 95%CI[1.21, 1.54], P<0.000 01), albumin(SMD=0.78, 95%CI[0.57, 0.98], P<0.000 01), and triglyceride(SMD=0.29, 95%CI[0.07, 0.50], P=0.01) in patients with hemodialysis to improve their nutritional status.(3)Bailing Capsules reduced the incidence of cardiovascular events(RR=0.45, 95%CI[0.34, 0.59], P<0.000 01).(4)A total of six patients presented with mild gastrointestinal discomfort after receiving Bailing Capsules, and no serious adverse reactions were observed.
