all_evidence.outcome: The proportions of patients with adverse and serious adverse events were similar in both treatment groups.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: In both trials, Hgb concentration was maintained from baseline to EoT in the FPC group but decreased by 0.4 g/dL in the placebo group (P < 0.001, combined results; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.2-0.6).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 두 연구 모두 FPC군의 Hgb 농도는 기저치부터 연구 종료 시점까지 유지됐지만 위약군에서는 0.4 g/dL 감소했습니다(P<0.001; 통합 결과 95% 신뢰구간 0.2~0.6).
all_evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Administration of ferric pyrophosphate citrate (FPC, Triferic™) via hemodialysate may allow replacement of ongoing uremic and hemodialysis-related iron losses. | METHODS: Two identical Phase 3, randomized, placebo-controlled trials (CRUISE 1 and 2) were conducted in 599 iron-replete chronic hemodialysis patients. | CONCLUSIONS: FPC delivered via dialysate during hemodialysis replaces iron losses, maintains Hgb concentrations, does not increase iron stores and exhibits a safety profile similar to placebo.

all_evidence.title: Inflammation-Driven Differential Response to Intravenous versus Oral Iron Supplementation in Hemodialysis Patients: A post hoc Analysis of the IHOPE Trial.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: Patients with elevated hsCRP showed poorer hemoglobin responses to intravenous iron sucrose, while oral polysaccharide-iron complex maintained consistent efficacy across inflammatory states.
all_evidence.outcome: Iron parameters and adverse events were comparable across groups.
all_evidence.key_finding: Patients with elevated hsCRP showed poorer hemoglobin responses to intravenous iron sucrose, while oral polysaccharide-iron complex maintained consistent efficacy across inflammatory states.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: hsCRP가 상승한 환자는 정맥 철 sucrose에 대한 혈색소 반응이 더 나빴지만, 경구 다당류 철 복합체는 염증 상태 전반에서 일관된 효능을 유지했습니다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Comparative Study|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Anemia is common in hemodialysis patients, and iron supplementation is essential for its management. | METHODS: This post hoc analysis of the IHOPE trial included 193 maintenance hemodialysis patients stratified by median baseline high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP). | CONCLUSION: This post hoc analysis suggests baseline inflammation significantly modifies responses to specific iron formulations in hemodialysis patients.

all_evidence.title: Randomized trial of two maintenance doses of vitamin D in children with chronic kidney disease.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: In children with CKD stages 3-5, a dose of vitamin D3 4000 IU daily was effective in achieving or maintaining vitamin D sufficiency.
all_evidence.outcome: None of the patients developed vitamin D toxicity or hypercalcemia.
all_evidence.key_finding: In children with CKD stages 3-5, a dose of vitamin D3 4000 IU daily was effective in achieving or maintaining vitamin D sufficiency.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 만성콩팥병 3단계에서 5단계 소아에서 비타민D3 4000 IU를 매일 투여하는 것은 비타민D 충분 상태를 달성하거나 유지하는 데 효과적이었습니다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Correction of nutritional vitamin deficiency is recommended in children with chronic kidney disease (CKD). | METHODS: We conducted a phase III, double-blind, randomized trial of two doses of vitamin D3 in children ≥ 9 years of age with CKD stages 3-5 or kidney transplant recipients. | CONCLUSIONS: In children with CKD, 1000 IU of daily vitamin D3 is unlikely to achieve or maintain a plasma 25(OH)D ≥ 30 ng/mL.

all_evidence.title: The role of nutritional vitamin D on microinflammation and nutritional status in maintenance hemodialysis patients: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
all_evidence.outcome: Key outcomes included CRP, serum albumin, TNF-α, IL-1β, immunoreactive Parathyroid Hormone (iPTH), adverse events, hypercalcemia, and hyperphosphatemia. | In terms of safety, the overall incidence of adverse reactions in the nutritional vitamin D group was similar to that in the control group (P = 0.09). | Moreover, no significant differences were found in the incidence of hypercalcemia and hyperphosphatemia between the two groups (P = 0.15, P = 0.32).
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 영양학적 비타민 D 보충은 혈액투석 환자의 미세염증과 영양상태를 개선할 수 있고, 고칼슘혈증이나 고인산혈증 위험을 뚜렷하게 높이지 않으면서 뼈 대사에도 이득이 있을 수 있다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Microinflammation is widespread in Maintenance hemodialysis (MHD) patients. | Nutritional vitamin D deficiency is closely related to chronic kidney disease inflammation, but whether correcting this deficiency can improve microinflammation in the MHD population remains unclear.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of pharmacological treatments for restless legs syndrome in hemodialysis patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_20: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
all_evidence.outcome: The primary outcome was change in International Restless Legs Scale (IRLS) scores; secondary outcomes included sleep quality, quality of life, dialysis adequacy, and adverse events. | Adverse events increased modestly (RR 1.28), highest with dopaminergic agents. | A heatmap further revealed that dopaminergic agents were associated with the highest frequency of adverse events, particularly nausea, hypotension, and augmentation.
all_evidence.key_finding: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 도파민 작용제는 유익하지만 이상반응 위험이 더 높다는 제한이 있고, 철분 치료는 내약성이 양호하면서 중등도 이득을 보였다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS) is highly prevalent among adults receiving maintenance hemodialysis and significantly impairs sleep, psychological well-being, and quality of life. | While Western pharmacological treatments such as dopaminergic agents, gabapentinoids, and iron therapy are commonly studied, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is also widely used in clinical practice-particularly for syndromes corresponding to RLS such as blood deficiency (Xue Xu), liver-kidney yin deficiency (Gan Shen Bu Zu), and blood stasis (Xue Yu). | However, the evidence base for TCM pharmacologic interventions in hemodialysis-related RLS remains unclear.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and Safety of Ferric Citrate on Hyperphosphatemia among Chinese Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease Undergoing Hemodialysis: A Phase III Multicenter Randomized Open-Label Active-Drug-Controlled Study.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
all_evidence.outcome: INTRODUCTION: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients is positively associated with mortality. | Frequency and severity of adverse events were recorded. | There are 47 (40.5%) patients in the ferric citrate group, and 26 (21.3%) patients in the sevelamer carbonate group experienced drug-related treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs); most were mild and tolerable.
all_evidence.key_finding: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 구연산철은 혈청 인 수치를 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L로 낮췄고, 세벨라머 탄산염의 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L와 비슷했다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Multicenter Study|Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients is positively associated with mortality. | We compared its efficacy and safety with active drugs in Chinese CKD patients with hemodialysis. | METHODS: Chinese patients undergoing hemodialysis were randomized into two treatment groups in a 1:1 ratio, receiving either ferric citrate or sevelamer carbonate, respectively, for 12 weeks.

all_evidence.title: Add-on astragalus in type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease: A multi-center, assessor-blind, randomized controlled trial.
all_evidence.venue: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: In patients with type 2 diabetes, stage 2 to 3 CKD and macroalbuminuria, add-on astragalus for 48 weeks further stabilized kidney function on top of standard care.
all_evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included endpoint blood pressures, biochemistry, biomarkers, concomitant drug change and adverse events. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03535935) RESULTS: During the 48-week period, the estimated difference in the slope of eGFR decline was 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2 per year (95 %CI: 1.5 to 7.6, p = 0.003) slower with astragalus. | 117 adverse events from 31 astragalus-treated patients and 41 standard care-controlled patients were documented.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: In patients with type 2 diabetes, stage 2 to 3 CKD and macroalbuminuria, add-on astragalus for 48 weeks further stabilized kidney function on top of standard care.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 제2형 당뇨병, 2-3기 CKD, 거대알부민뇨 환자에서 48주간 황기를 추가하면 표준치료에 더해 신장기능이 안정화되었다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Diabetes leads to chronic kidney disease (CKD) and kidney failure, requiring dialysis or transplantation. | Astragalus, a common herbal medicine and US pharmacopeia-registered food ingredient, is shown kidney protective by retrospective and preclinical data but with limited long-term prospective clinical evidence. | This trial aimed to assess the effectiveness of astragalus on kidney function decline in macroalbuminuric diabetic CKD patients.

all_evidence.title: Effects of turmeric and curcumin in patients on dialysis or using immunosuppressive agents: a systematic review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: According to high-quality studies, turmeric and curcumin demonstrated antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits in HD patients; however, these compounds did not exhibit a lipid-lowering effect.
all_evidence.outcome: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs. | Conversely, a food-drug interaction between immunosuppressive drugs and high doses of turmeric caused nephrotoxicity.
all_evidence.key_finding: According to high-quality studies, turmeric and curcumin demonstrated antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits in HD patients; however, these compounds did not exhibit a lipid-lowering effect.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 질 높은 연구에서 강황과 커큐민은 혈액투석 환자에게 항산화·항염 효과를 보였지만 지질 저하 효과는 보이지 않았다.
all_evidence.population: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs. | Turmeric (Curcuma longa) and its active compound, curcumin, demonstrate nephroprotective effects through their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-apoptotic properties. | This article evaluates the effects of turmeric and curcumin as interventions to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in HD patients and as nephroprotective agents in patients undergoing immunosuppressive therapy.

output: 연구에서 관찰된 대상·노출·결과와 근거 문장을 연결해 표시합니다. 이 출력은 임상 판단, 복용 시작·중단 또는 용량 변경을 지시하지 않습니다.

evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 여러 전향적 연구에서 엽산을 매일 800 µg 이상 또는 3~6개월을 초과해 복용하면, 특히 임신 전 시작했을 때 임신성 당뇨병 발생 오즈가 높아질 수 있다고 제시했습니다.
evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.

evidence.title: Systematic Literature Review and Meta-Analysis of the Relationship Between Polyunsaturated and Trans Fatty Acids During Pregnancy and Offspring Weight Development.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_5: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding_ko: DHA 및/또는 EPA를 하루 650 mg 초과 보충한 경우 출생체중(MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n=3,831)과 5-10세의 BMI 및 BMI z 점수(SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n=3,220)가 약간 더 높았다.
evidence.population: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis according to PRISMA guidelines to evaluate whether levels of these fatty acids during pregnancy influenced offspring weight development. | Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with DHA and/or EPA supplementation or cohort studies, which examined levels of DHA, EPA, or TFAs in maternal or neonatal blood samples and recorded offspring weight, were included. | The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).

evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
evidence.key_finding: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 전체적으로 교란요인을 보정한 관찰연구에서는 임신 중 허브 사용과 주요 자녀 이상 결과(선천성 기형, 유산, 사산, 조산 포함)의 유의한 연관성이 나타나지 않았다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose versus oral iron in pregnant women with anemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
all_evidence.outcome: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose. | CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 정맥 철 카복시말토스는 빈혈이 있는 임산부의 혈액학적 지표 개선에서 경구 철분보다 더 효과적인 것으로 보이며, 약물 관련 이상반응과 오심이 더 적은 것을 포함해 양호한 내약성 양상을 보입니다.
all_evidence.population: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of IV ferric carboxymaltose compared with oral iron in managing pregnancy-related anemia. | MATERIALS AND METHODS: We systematically searched four databases for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohorts comparing IV ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia. | Randomized controlled trials and observational cohorts comparing intravenous ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia were included.

all_evidence.title: DHA Supplementation During Pregnancy Enhances Maternal Vagally Mediated Cardiac Autonomic Control in Humans.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
all_evidence.outcome: Longitudinal studies examining the potential link between DHA, enhanced vagal tone, and reported reduction in early preterm birth are warranted.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 중 DHA 800 mg/d를 받은 여성은 200 mg/d를 받은 여성보다 심박수와 교감신경 지수가 낮고, 미주신경 매개 심박변이도 지표와 심박변이도 복잡성이 높았습니다(모두 P<0.05).
all_evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Journal Article|Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVES: The objective of this secondary analysis was to determine if DHA was related to maternal heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) metrics in a large cohort of pregnant women. | METHODS: In the parent trial (1R01HD086001) eligible participants (≥18 y old, English speaking, carrying a singleton pregnancy, 12-20 wk of gestation) were randomly assigned to consume 200 mg/d or 800 mg/d DHA for the duration of their pregnancy (n = 300). | Weight, blood pressure, and magnetocardiograms (MCGs) were collected at 32 wk and 36 wk of gestation (n = 221).

all_evidence.title: Nutrition and reproductive potential of women in low- and middle-income countries: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence).
all_evidence.outcome: Outcomes of interest included fertility and fecundity, menarche and menstrual disorders, miscarriage, stillbirth and live birth. | From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence). | From observational cohort studies, preconceptional obesity was associated with a greater risk of miscarriage (12 studies; RR: 1.27; 95% CI 1.10, 1.47; very low certainty of evidence) and stillbirth (4 studies; RR: 1.66; 95% CI 1.28, 2.14; very low certainty of evidence).
all_evidence.key_finding: From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence).

all_evidence.title: Maternal weight status, diet, and supplement use as determinants of breastfeeding and complementary feeding: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: Maternal underweight, diet, and supplement use were not associated with infant feeding practices.
all_evidence.outcome: DATA SOURCES: A systematic literature search of the Embase, Cochrane Library, Google Scholar, MEDLINE, PubMed, and Web of Science databases was performed.
all_evidence.key_finding: Maternal underweight, diet, and supplement use were not associated with infant feeding practices.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 산모의 저체중, 식이, 보충제 사용은 영아 수유 관행과 관련이 없었습니다.
all_evidence.population: CONTEXT: Infant feeding practices are influenced by maternal factors. | OBJECTIVE: The aim of this review is to examine the associations between maternal weight status or dietary characteristics and breastfeeding or complementary feeding. | STUDY SELECTION: Interventional and cohort studies in healthy mothers and infants that reported on maternal weight status, diet, or supplement use were selected.

all_evidence.title: Maternal exposure to folate antagonists and susceptibility to congenital heart disease in offspring: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: Notably, the protective effect of folic acid supplementation was reported in cases of congenital heart disease linked to dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors but not that associated with antiepileptic drugs.
all_evidence.outcome: AIMS: The objective of this meta-analysis was to determine whether maternal exposure to folate antagonists is associated with increased rates of congenital heart disease in offspring. | RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control. | CONCLUSION: Administration of folate antagonists within the 12-week period preceding conception and throughout the second and third months of gestation exhibited a statistically significant elevation in the susceptibility to congenital heart diseases.
all_evidence.key_finding: Notably, the protective effect of folic acid supplementation was reported in cases of congenital heart disease linked to dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors but not that associated with antiepileptic drugs.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 특히 엽산 보충의 보호효과는 디하이드로엽산 환원효소 억제제와 연관된 선천성 심장질환에서 보고됐지만, 항간질약과 연관된 질환에서는 보고되지 않았다.

all_evidence.title: The effect of folic acid intake on congenital anomalies. A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: Specifically, children whose mothers received periconceptional folic acid supplementation had a 77% reduced risk of congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Congenital anomalies pose a significant challenge to global health and result in considerable morbidity and mortality in early childhood. | With the decline of other causes of death among children under five, the burden of congenital anomalies is rising, emphasizing the need for improved prenatal care, screening, and nutrition for pregnant women. | This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to estimate the pooled effect of folic acid intake on congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.key_finding: Specifically, children whose mothers received periconceptional folic acid supplementation had a 77% reduced risk of congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 구체적으로 임신 전후에 엽산 보충을 받은 산모의 자녀는 선천기형 위험이 77% 낮았습니다.
all_evidence.population: With the decline of other causes of death among children under five, the burden of congenital anomalies is rising, emphasizing the need for improved prenatal care, screening, and nutrition for pregnant women. | We computed the pooled effect size with 95% confidence intervals for maternal folic acid intake on congenital anomalies using STATA version 17 and the DerSimonian and Laird random effects meta-analysis model. | According to the results of this systematic review and meta-analysis, maternal folic acid intake significantly lowers the incidence of congenital anomalies (odds ratio (OR), 0.23; confidence interval (CI), 0.16, 0.32).

all_evidence.title: The Impact of Minerals on Female Fertility: A Systematic Review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSIONS: This review highlights the crucial role of both mineral supplementation and serum mineral status in female fertility.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the multifaceted role of minerals in female fertility, focusing on key areas such as oocyte quality, ovulation, embryo development, oxidative stress, miscarriage, hormonal regulation, environmental exposure, and in-vitro fertilization (IVF) outcomes. | Relevant literature was sourced from multiple electronic databases, including PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library, using keywords related to minerals and female fertility. | The studies addressed various reproductive outcomes influenced by minerals: embryo development, oocyte quality, oxidative stress, miscarriage, hormonal regulation, IVF outcomes, environmental exposure, and minerals as biomarkers.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: This review highlights the crucial role of both mineral supplementation and serum mineral status in female fertility.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 리뷰는 여성 생식능력에서 미네랄 보충과 혈청 미네랄 상태가 모두 중요한 역할을 한다는 점을 강조합니다.
all_evidence.population: METHODS: A systematic review was conducted, focusing on randomized controlled trials (RCTs), prospective cohort studies, case-control studies, nested case-control, and observational studies examining mineral supplementation and nutrition in women planning pregnancy or utilizing assisted reproduction technologies (ARTs).

all_evidence.title: Vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy and maternal and neonatal outcomes: results from a quantitative umbrella meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: Vitamin D supplementation lowered the risk of GDM (RR = 0.68, 95%CI: 0.53 to 0.88), preeclampsia (RR = 0.62, 95%CI: 0.56 to 0.69), PTD (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.65 to 0.90), LBW (RR = 0.67, 95%CI: 0.54 to 0.84), SGA (RR = 0.73, 95%CI: 0.63 to 0.85), stillbirth (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.62 to 0.95), and neonatal mortality (RR = 0.58, 95%CI: 0.40 to 0.84), while also enhanced birth weight (SMD = 75.68, 95%CI: 48.99 to 102.36), birth length (SMD = 0.25, 95%CI: 0.18 to 0.33), and head circumference (SMD = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.06 to 0.23).
all_evidence.outcome: The outcomes included gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), preeclampsia, cesarean section, preterm delivery (PTD), low birth weight (LBW), small for gestational age (SGA), stillbirth, neonatal mortality, birth weight, birth length, and head circumference at birth. | Vitamin D supplementation lowered the risk of GDM (RR = 0.68, 95%CI: 0.53 to 0.88), preeclampsia (RR = 0.62, 95%CI: 0.56 to 0.69), PTD (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.65 to 0.90), LBW (RR = 0.67, 95%CI: 0.54 to 0.84), SGA (RR = 0.73, 95%CI: 0.63 to 0.85), stillbirth (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.62 to 0.95), and neonatal mortality (RR = 0.58, 95%CI: 0.40 to 0.84), while also enhanced birth weight (SMD = 75.68, 95%CI: 48.99 to 102.36), birth length (SMD = 0.25, 95%CI: 0.18 to 0.33), and head circumference (SMD = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.06 to 0.23). | CONCLUSIONS: Prenatal vitamin D supplementation may be associated with a lower risk of certain adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes and may improve birth anthropometric measurements.
all_evidence.key_finding: Vitamin D supplementation lowered the risk of GDM (RR = 0.68, 95%CI: 0.53 to 0.88), preeclampsia (RR = 0.62, 95%CI: 0.56 to 0.69), PTD (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.65 to 0.90), LBW (RR = 0.67, 95%CI: 0.54 to 0.84), SGA (RR = 0.73, 95%CI: 0.63 to 0.85), stillbirth (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.62 to 0.95), and neonatal mortality (RR = 0.58, 95%CI: 0.40 to 0.84), while also enhanced birth weight (SMD = 75.68, 95%CI: 48.99 to 102.36), birth length (SMD = 0.25, 95%CI: 0.18 to 0.33), and head circumference (SMD = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.06 to 0.23).
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: This umbrella meta-analysis aimed to examine the effect of prenatal vitamin D supplementation on maternal and neonatal outcomes. | The outcomes included gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), preeclampsia, cesarean section, preterm delivery (PTD), low birth weight (LBW), small for gestational age (SGA), stillbirth, neonatal mortality, birth weight, birth length, and head circumference at birth. | Vitamin D supplementation lowered the risk of GDM (RR = 0.68, 95%CI: 0.53 to 0.88), preeclampsia (RR = 0.62, 95%CI: 0.56 to 0.69), PTD (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.65 to 0.90), LBW (RR = 0.67, 95%CI: 0.54 to 0.84), SGA (RR = 0.73, 95%CI: 0.63 to 0.85), stillbirth (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.62 to 0.95), and neonatal mortality (RR = 0.58, 95%CI: 0.40 to 0.84), while also enhanced birth weight (SMD = 75.68, 95%CI: 48.99 to 102.36), birth length (SMD = 0.25, 95%CI: 0.18 to 0.33), and head circumference (SMD = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.06 to 0.23).

all_evidence.title: Effects of Selenium Administration on Blood Lipids: A Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis of Experimental Human Studies.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: DATA ANALYSIS: Dose-response analysis indicated that selenium administration at and above 200 µg/day decreased HDL and LDL cholesterol and increased triglyceride levels.
all_evidence.outcome: CONTEXT: Overexposure to the essential trace element selenium has been associated with adverse metabolic and cardiovascular outcomes, hypertension, and diabetes. | The adverse effects of selenium were stronger in studies involving healthy participants as compared with unhealthy participants and pregnant females, in those having a longer duration of the intervention, particularly more than 3 months, and in European populations at selenium intake levels of above 300 µg/day. | CONCLUSIONS: In this dose-response meta-analysis of experimental human studies, an adverse effect of selenium administration on blood lipids at levels around or above the current upper level of intake was observed.
all_evidence.key_finding: DATA ANALYSIS: Dose-response analysis indicated that selenium administration at and above 200 µg/day decreased HDL and LDL cholesterol and increased triglyceride levels.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 자료 분석: 용량 반응 분석에서 셀레늄을 200 µg/day 이상 투여하면 HDL 및 LDL 콜레스테롤이 감소하고 중성지방 수치가 증가했습니다.
all_evidence.population: DATA EXTRACTION: A total of 27 eligible RCTs that enrolled healthy individuals, pregnant individuals, and participants with specific health conditions were identified and the relevant data was extracted. | The adverse effects of selenium were stronger in studies involving healthy participants as compared with unhealthy participants and pregnant females, in those having a longer duration of the intervention, particularly more than 3 months, and in European populations at selenium intake levels of above 300 µg/day.

all_evidence.title: Is antenatal or early-life vitamin D associated with eczema or food allergy in childhood? A systematic review.

all_evidence.key_finding: Four RCTs of vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy showed no evidence of an effect on the incidence of eczema (pooled odds ratio [OR] = 0.85; 0.67-1.08, I2  = 6.7%, n = 2074).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 중 비타민D 보충을 평가한 4개의 RCT에서 습진 발생률에 대한 효과의 증거는 없었습니다(통합 오즈비[OR] = 0.85; 0.67-1.08, I2  = 6.7%, n = 2074).

all_evidence.title: The effect of selenium supplementation in pregnant women on maternal, fetal, and newborn outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.venue: American journal of obstetrics & gynecology MFM
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: CONCLUSION: There is limited evidence on the effects of selenium supplementation during pregnancy.
all_evidence.outcome: OBJECTIVE: Low maternal selenium status has been associated with poor pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth. | This study aimed to evaluate available evidence of the effects of selenium supplementation during pregnancy on preterm birth and related maternal, fetal, and newborn outcomes. | RESULTS: Literature searches identified 5105 unique records, and 32 studies met the eligibility criteria.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: There is limited evidence on the effects of selenium supplementation during pregnancy.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 임신 중 셀레늄 보충의 효과에 관한 근거는 제한적입니다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Meta-Analysis|Systematic Review|Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: Low maternal selenium status has been associated with poor pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth. | This study aimed to evaluate available evidence of the effects of selenium supplementation during pregnancy on preterm birth and related maternal, fetal, and newborn outcomes. | STUDY ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Randomized controlled trials and nonrandomized interventional studies were included if they compared the effects of selenium supplementation with placebo or no treatment among pregnant women.

evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 여러 전향적 연구에서 엽산을 매일 800 µg 이상 또는 3~6개월을 초과해 복용하면, 특히 임신 전 시작했을 때 임신성 당뇨병 발생 오즈가 높아질 수 있다고 제시했습니다.
evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.

evidence.title: Systematic Literature Review and Meta-Analysis of the Relationship Between Polyunsaturated and Trans Fatty Acids During Pregnancy and Offspring Weight Development.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_5: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding_ko: DHA 및/또는 EPA를 하루 650 mg 초과 보충한 경우 출생체중(MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n=3,831)과 5-10세의 BMI 및 BMI z 점수(SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n=3,220)가 약간 더 높았다.
evidence.population: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis according to PRISMA guidelines to evaluate whether levels of these fatty acids during pregnancy influenced offspring weight development. | Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with DHA and/or EPA supplementation or cohort studies, which examined levels of DHA, EPA, or TFAs in maternal or neonatal blood samples and recorded offspring weight, were included. | The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).

all_evidence.title: Maternal weight status, diet, and supplement use as determinants of breastfeeding and complementary feeding: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: Maternal underweight, diet, and supplement use were not associated with infant feeding practices.
all_evidence.outcome: DATA SOURCES: A systematic literature search of the Embase, Cochrane Library, Google Scholar, MEDLINE, PubMed, and Web of Science databases was performed.
all_evidence.key_finding: Maternal underweight, diet, and supplement use were not associated with infant feeding practices.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 산모의 저체중, 식이, 보충제 사용은 영아 수유 관행과 관련이 없었습니다.
all_evidence.population: CONTEXT: Infant feeding practices are influenced by maternal factors. | OBJECTIVE: The aim of this review is to examine the associations between maternal weight status or dietary characteristics and breastfeeding or complementary feeding. | STUDY SELECTION: Interventional and cohort studies in healthy mothers and infants that reported on maternal weight status, diet, or supplement use were selected.

all_evidence.title: The effect of folic acid intake on congenital anomalies. A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: Specifically, children whose mothers received periconceptional folic acid supplementation had a 77% reduced risk of congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Congenital anomalies pose a significant challenge to global health and result in considerable morbidity and mortality in early childhood. | With the decline of other causes of death among children under five, the burden of congenital anomalies is rising, emphasizing the need for improved prenatal care, screening, and nutrition for pregnant women. | This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to estimate the pooled effect of folic acid intake on congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.key_finding: Specifically, children whose mothers received periconceptional folic acid supplementation had a 77% reduced risk of congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 구체적으로 임신 전후에 엽산 보충을 받은 산모의 자녀는 선천기형 위험이 77% 낮았습니다.
all_evidence.population: With the decline of other causes of death among children under five, the burden of congenital anomalies is rising, emphasizing the need for improved prenatal care, screening, and nutrition for pregnant women. | We computed the pooled effect size with 95% confidence intervals for maternal folic acid intake on congenital anomalies using STATA version 17 and the DerSimonian and Laird random effects meta-analysis model. | According to the results of this systematic review and meta-analysis, maternal folic acid intake significantly lowers the incidence of congenital anomalies (odds ratio (OR), 0.23; confidence interval (CI), 0.16, 0.32).

all_evidence.title: Vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy and maternal and neonatal outcomes: results from a quantitative umbrella meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: Vitamin D supplementation lowered the risk of GDM (RR = 0.68, 95%CI: 0.53 to 0.88), preeclampsia (RR = 0.62, 95%CI: 0.56 to 0.69), PTD (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.65 to 0.90), LBW (RR = 0.67, 95%CI: 0.54 to 0.84), SGA (RR = 0.73, 95%CI: 0.63 to 0.85), stillbirth (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.62 to 0.95), and neonatal mortality (RR = 0.58, 95%CI: 0.40 to 0.84), while also enhanced birth weight (SMD = 75.68, 95%CI: 48.99 to 102.36), birth length (SMD = 0.25, 95%CI: 0.18 to 0.33), and head circumference (SMD = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.06 to 0.23).

all_evidence.title: Effects of Selenium Administration on Blood Lipids: A Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis of Experimental Human Studies.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: DATA ANALYSIS: Dose-response analysis indicated that selenium administration at and above 200 µg/day decreased HDL and LDL cholesterol and increased triglyceride levels.
all_evidence.outcome: CONTEXT: Overexposure to the essential trace element selenium has been associated with adverse metabolic and cardiovascular outcomes, hypertension, and diabetes. | The adverse effects of selenium were stronger in studies involving healthy participants as compared with unhealthy participants and pregnant females, in those having a longer duration of the intervention, particularly more than 3 months, and in European populations at selenium intake levels of above 300 µg/day. | CONCLUSIONS: In this dose-response meta-analysis of experimental human studies, an adverse effect of selenium administration on blood lipids at levels around or above the current upper level of intake was observed.
all_evidence.key_finding: DATA ANALYSIS: Dose-response analysis indicated that selenium administration at and above 200 µg/day decreased HDL and LDL cholesterol and increased triglyceride levels.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 자료 분석: 용량 반응 분석에서 셀레늄을 200 µg/day 이상 투여하면 HDL 및 LDL 콜레스테롤이 감소하고 중성지방 수치가 증가했습니다.
all_evidence.population: DATA EXTRACTION: A total of 27 eligible RCTs that enrolled healthy individuals, pregnant individuals, and participants with specific health conditions were identified and the relevant data was extracted. | The adverse effects of selenium were stronger in studies involving healthy participants as compared with unhealthy participants and pregnant females, in those having a longer duration of the intervention, particularly more than 3 months, and in European populations at selenium intake levels of above 300 µg/day.

all_evidence.key_finding: Four RCTs of vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy showed no evidence of an effect on the incidence of eczema (pooled odds ratio [OR] = 0.85; 0.67-1.08, I2  = 6.7%, n = 2074).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 중 비타민D 보충을 평가한 4개의 RCT에서 습진 발생률에 대한 효과의 증거는 없었습니다(통합 오즈비[OR] = 0.85; 0.67-1.08, I2  = 6.7%, n = 2074).
all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review

all_evidence.title: The effect of selenium supplementation in pregnant women on maternal, fetal, and newborn outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.venue: American journal of obstetrics & gynecology MFM
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: CONCLUSION: There is limited evidence on the effects of selenium supplementation during pregnancy.

all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: There is limited evidence on the effects of selenium supplementation during pregnancy.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 임신 중 셀레늄 보충의 효과에 관한 근거는 제한적입니다.

evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 여러 전향적 연구에서 엽산을 매일 800 µg 이상 또는 3~6개월을 초과해 복용하면, 특히 임신 전 시작했을 때 임신성 당뇨병 발생 오즈가 높아질 수 있다고 제시했습니다.
evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.

evidence.title: Systematic Literature Review and Meta-Analysis of the Relationship Between Polyunsaturated and Trans Fatty Acids During Pregnancy and Offspring Weight Development.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_5: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding_ko: DHA 및/또는 EPA를 하루 650 mg 초과 보충한 경우 출생체중(MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n=3,831)과 5-10세의 BMI 및 BMI z 점수(SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n=3,220)가 약간 더 높았다.
evidence.population: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis according to PRISMA guidelines to evaluate whether levels of these fatty acids during pregnancy influenced offspring weight development. | Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with DHA and/or EPA supplementation or cohort studies, which examined levels of DHA, EPA, or TFAs in maternal or neonatal blood samples and recorded offspring weight, were included. | The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).

evidence.title: DHA Supplementation During Pregnancy Enhances Maternal Vagally Mediated Cardiac Autonomic Control in Humans.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
evidence.outcome: Longitudinal studies examining the potential link between DHA, enhanced vagal tone, and reported reduction in early preterm birth are warranted.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 중 DHA 800 mg/d를 받은 여성은 200 mg/d를 받은 여성보다 심박수와 교감신경 지수가 낮고, 미주신경 매개 심박변이도 지표와 심박변이도 복잡성이 높았습니다(모두 P<0.05).
evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Journal Article|Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural
evidence.population: OBJECTIVES: The objective of this secondary analysis was to determine if DHA was related to maternal heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) metrics in a large cohort of pregnant women. | METHODS: In the parent trial (1R01HD086001) eligible participants (≥18 y old, English speaking, carrying a singleton pregnancy, 12-20 wk of gestation) were randomly assigned to consume 200 mg/d or 800 mg/d DHA for the duration of their pregnancy (n = 300). | Weight, blood pressure, and magnetocardiograms (MCGs) were collected at 32 wk and 36 wk of gestation (n = 221).

all_evidence.title: Effects of Selenium Administration on Blood Lipids: A Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis of Experimental Human Studies.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: DATA ANALYSIS: Dose-response analysis indicated that selenium administration at and above 200 µg/day decreased HDL and LDL cholesterol and increased triglyceride levels.
all_evidence.outcome: CONTEXT: Overexposure to the essential trace element selenium has been associated with adverse metabolic and cardiovascular outcomes, hypertension, and diabetes. | The adverse effects of selenium were stronger in studies involving healthy participants as compared with unhealthy participants and pregnant females, in those having a longer duration of the intervention, particularly more than 3 months, and in European populations at selenium intake levels of above 300 µg/day. | CONCLUSIONS: In this dose-response meta-analysis of experimental human studies, an adverse effect of selenium administration on blood lipids at levels around or above the current upper level of intake was observed.

all_evidence.population: DATA EXTRACTION: A total of 27 eligible RCTs that enrolled healthy individuals, pregnant individuals, and participants with specific health conditions were identified and the relevant data was extracted. | The adverse effects of selenium were stronger in studies involving healthy participants as compared with unhealthy participants and pregnant females, in those having a longer duration of the intervention, particularly more than 3 months, and in European populations at selenium intake levels of above 300 µg/day.

evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
evidence.key_finding: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 전체적으로 교란요인을 보정한 관찰연구에서는 임신 중 허브 사용과 주요 자녀 이상 결과(선천성 기형, 유산, 사산, 조산 포함)의 유의한 연관성이 나타나지 않았다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose versus oral iron in pregnant women with anemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
evidence.outcome: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose. | CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 정맥 철 카복시말토스는 빈혈이 있는 임산부의 혈액학적 지표 개선에서 경구 철분보다 더 효과적인 것으로 보이며, 약물 관련 이상반응과 오심이 더 적은 것을 포함해 양호한 내약성 양상을 보입니다.
evidence.population: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of IV ferric carboxymaltose compared with oral iron in managing pregnancy-related anemia. | MATERIALS AND METHODS: We systematically searched four databases for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohorts comparing IV ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia. | Randomized controlled trials and observational cohorts comparing intravenous ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia were included.

evidence.title: DHA Supplementation During Pregnancy Enhances Maternal Vagally Mediated Cardiac Autonomic Control in Humans.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
evidence.outcome: Longitudinal studies examining the potential link between DHA, enhanced vagal tone, and reported reduction in early preterm birth are warranted.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 중 DHA 800 mg/d를 받은 여성은 200 mg/d를 받은 여성보다 심박수와 교감신경 지수가 낮고, 미주신경 매개 심박변이도 지표와 심박변이도 복잡성이 높았습니다(모두 P<0.05).
evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Journal Article|Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural
evidence.population: OBJECTIVES: The objective of this secondary analysis was to determine if DHA was related to maternal heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) metrics in a large cohort of pregnant women. | METHODS: In the parent trial (1R01HD086001) eligible participants (≥18 y old, English speaking, carrying a singleton pregnancy, 12-20 wk of gestation) were randomly assigned to consume 200 mg/d or 800 mg/d DHA for the duration of their pregnancy (n = 300). | Weight, blood pressure, and magnetocardiograms (MCGs) were collected at 32 wk and 36 wk of gestation (n = 221).

all_evidence.title: Maternal weight status, diet, and supplement use as determinants of breastfeeding and complementary feeding: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: Maternal underweight, diet, and supplement use were not associated with infant feeding practices.
all_evidence.outcome: DATA SOURCES: A systematic literature search of the Embase, Cochrane Library, Google Scholar, MEDLINE, PubMed, and Web of Science databases was performed.
all_evidence.key_finding: Maternal underweight, diet, and supplement use were not associated with infant feeding practices.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 산모의 저체중, 식이, 보충제 사용은 영아 수유 관행과 관련이 없었습니다.
all_evidence.population: CONTEXT: Infant feeding practices are influenced by maternal factors. | OBJECTIVE: The aim of this review is to examine the associations between maternal weight status or dietary characteristics and breastfeeding or complementary feeding. | STUDY SELECTION: Interventional and cohort studies in healthy mothers and infants that reported on maternal weight status, diet, or supplement use were selected.

all_evidence.title: The effect of folic acid intake on congenital anomalies. A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: Specifically, children whose mothers received periconceptional folic acid supplementation had a 77% reduced risk of congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Congenital anomalies pose a significant challenge to global health and result in considerable morbidity and mortality in early childhood. | With the decline of other causes of death among children under five, the burden of congenital anomalies is rising, emphasizing the need for improved prenatal care, screening, and nutrition for pregnant women. | This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to estimate the pooled effect of folic acid intake on congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.key_finding: Specifically, children whose mothers received periconceptional folic acid supplementation had a 77% reduced risk of congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 구체적으로 임신 전후에 엽산 보충을 받은 산모의 자녀는 선천기형 위험이 77% 낮았습니다.
all_evidence.population: With the decline of other causes of death among children under five, the burden of congenital anomalies is rising, emphasizing the need for improved prenatal care, screening, and nutrition for pregnant women. | We computed the pooled effect size with 95% confidence intervals for maternal folic acid intake on congenital anomalies using STATA version 17 and the DerSimonian and Laird random effects meta-analysis model. | According to the results of this systematic review and meta-analysis, maternal folic acid intake significantly lowers the incidence of congenital anomalies (odds ratio (OR), 0.23; confidence interval (CI), 0.16, 0.32).

all_evidence.title: The Impact of Minerals on Female Fertility: A Systematic Review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSIONS: This review highlights the crucial role of both mineral supplementation and serum mineral status in female fertility.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the multifaceted role of minerals in female fertility, focusing on key areas such as oocyte quality, ovulation, embryo development, oxidative stress, miscarriage, hormonal regulation, environmental exposure, and in-vitro fertilization (IVF) outcomes. | Relevant literature was sourced from multiple electronic databases, including PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library, using keywords related to minerals and female fertility. | The studies addressed various reproductive outcomes influenced by minerals: embryo development, oocyte quality, oxidative stress, miscarriage, hormonal regulation, IVF outcomes, environmental exposure, and minerals as biomarkers.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: This review highlights the crucial role of both mineral supplementation and serum mineral status in female fertility.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 리뷰는 여성 생식능력에서 미네랄 보충과 혈청 미네랄 상태가 모두 중요한 역할을 한다는 점을 강조합니다.
all_evidence.population: METHODS: A systematic review was conducted, focusing on randomized controlled trials (RCTs), prospective cohort studies, case-control studies, nested case-control, and observational studies examining mineral supplementation and nutrition in women planning pregnancy or utilizing assisted reproduction technologies (ARTs).

all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: There is limited evidence on the effects of selenium supplementation during pregnancy.

evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 여러 전향적 연구에서 엽산을 매일 800 µg 이상 또는 3~6개월을 초과해 복용하면, 특히 임신 전 시작했을 때 임신성 당뇨병 발생 오즈가 높아질 수 있다고 제시했습니다.
evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.

evidence.title: Systematic Literature Review and Meta-Analysis of the Relationship Between Polyunsaturated and Trans Fatty Acids During Pregnancy and Offspring Weight Development.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_5: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding_ko: DHA 및/또는 EPA를 하루 650 mg 초과 보충한 경우 출생체중(MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n=3,831)과 5-10세의 BMI 및 BMI z 점수(SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n=3,220)가 약간 더 높았다.
evidence.population: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis according to PRISMA guidelines to evaluate whether levels of these fatty acids during pregnancy influenced offspring weight development. | Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with DHA and/or EPA supplementation or cohort studies, which examined levels of DHA, EPA, or TFAs in maternal or neonatal blood samples and recorded offspring weight, were included. | The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).

evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
evidence.key_finding: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 전체적으로 교란요인을 보정한 관찰연구에서는 임신 중 허브 사용과 주요 자녀 이상 결과(선천성 기형, 유산, 사산, 조산 포함)의 유의한 연관성이 나타나지 않았다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

all_evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
all_evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 여러 전향적 연구에서 엽산을 매일 800 µg 이상 또는 3~6개월을 초과해 복용하면, 특히 임신 전 시작했을 때 임신성 당뇨병 발생 오즈가 높아질 수 있다고 제시했습니다.
all_evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.
