all_evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose versus oral iron in pregnant women with anemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
all_evidence.outcome: Safety analyses demonstrated lower risks of drug-related adverse events (3 studies; 471 patients; RR = 0.42, 95% CI [0.19-0.91], p = 0.02) and nausea ( 3 studies; 3,284 patients; RR = 0.27, 95% CI [0.09-0.75], p = 0.012) with IV ferric carboxymaltose. | CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Intravenous ferric carboxymaltose appears more effective than oral iron in improving hematologic indices in pregnant women with anemia and shows a favorable tolerability profile, including fewer drug-related adverse events and nausea.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 정맥 철 카복시말토스는 빈혈이 있는 임산부의 혈액학적 지표 개선에서 경구 철분보다 더 효과적인 것으로 보이며, 약물 관련 이상반응과 오심이 더 적은 것을 포함해 양호한 내약성 양상을 보입니다.
all_evidence.population: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of IV ferric carboxymaltose compared with oral iron in managing pregnancy-related anemia. | MATERIALS AND METHODS: We systematically searched four databases for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohorts comparing IV ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia. | Randomized controlled trials and observational cohorts comparing intravenous ferric carboxymaltose with oral iron in pregnant women with anemia were included.

all_evidence.title: DHA Supplementation During Pregnancy Enhances Maternal Vagally Mediated Cardiac Autonomic Control in Humans.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
all_evidence.outcome: Longitudinal studies examining the potential link between DHA, enhanced vagal tone, and reported reduction in early preterm birth are warranted.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 중 DHA 800 mg/d를 받은 여성은 200 mg/d를 받은 여성보다 심박수와 교감신경 지수가 낮고, 미주신경 매개 심박변이도 지표와 심박변이도 복잡성이 높았습니다(모두 P<0.05).
all_evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Journal Article|Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVES: The objective of this secondary analysis was to determine if DHA was related to maternal heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) metrics in a large cohort of pregnant women. | METHODS: In the parent trial (1R01HD086001) eligible participants (≥18 y old, English speaking, carrying a singleton pregnancy, 12-20 wk of gestation) were randomly assigned to consume 200 mg/d or 800 mg/d DHA for the duration of their pregnancy (n = 300). | Weight, blood pressure, and magnetocardiograms (MCGs) were collected at 32 wk and 36 wk of gestation (n = 221).

all_evidence.title: Nutrition and reproductive potential of women in low- and middle-income countries: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence).
all_evidence.outcome: Outcomes of interest included fertility and fecundity, menarche and menstrual disorders, miscarriage, stillbirth and live birth. | From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence). | From observational cohort studies, preconceptional obesity was associated with a greater risk of miscarriage (12 studies; RR: 1.27; 95% CI 1.10, 1.47; very low certainty of evidence) and stillbirth (4 studies; RR: 1.66; 95% CI 1.28, 2.14; very low certainty of evidence).
all_evidence.key_finding: From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 무작위시험에서는 임신 중 복합 미량영양소 보충이 유산 위험에 영향을 준다는 명확한 근거가 없었습니다(8개 시험, RR 0.87, 95% CI 0.75~1.02; 근거 확실성 중간). 사산 위험도 마찬가지였습니다(15개 시험, RR 0.86, 95% CI 0.73~1.02; 근거 확실성 낮음).
all_evidence.population: Outcomes of interest included fertility and fecundity, menarche and menstrual disorders, miscarriage, stillbirth and live birth. | From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence). | From observational cohort studies, preconceptional obesity was associated with a greater risk of miscarriage (12 studies; RR: 1.27; 95% CI 1.10, 1.47; very low certainty of evidence) and stillbirth (4 studies; RR: 1.66; 95% CI 1.28, 2.14; very low certainty of evidence).

all_evidence.title: Risk factors of neuroblastoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: Maternal alcohol consumption during preconception/pregnancy, maternal intake of vitamin and folic acid during pregnancy, paternal occupational exposure to extremely low-frequency magnetic fields (ELF-MF), and maternal X-ray exposure during pregnancy were also not associated with the risk of NB.
all_evidence.outcome: The objective is to review literature and synthesize risk factors for NB.
all_evidence.key_finding: Maternal alcohol consumption during preconception/pregnancy, maternal intake of vitamin and folic acid during pregnancy, paternal occupational exposure to extremely low-frequency magnetic fields (ELF-MF), and maternal X-ray exposure during pregnancy were also not associated with the risk of NB.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 전·임신 중 모체의 음주, 임신 중 모체의 비타민·엽산 섭취, 부계의 극저주파 자기장 직업 노출, 임신 중 모체의 X선 노출은 신경모세포종 위험과도 연관되지 않았다.
all_evidence.population: We observed associations for maternal occupational exposure to pesticides during preconception/pregnancy (ES 1.62, CI 1.04-2.54), high birthweight [(>4,000 g) ES 1.21, CI 1.02-1.42], and Cesarean section (ES 1.14, CI 1.00-1.30) and the risk of NB. | Parental smoking showed a weak association, while breastfeeding ≥6 months (ES 0.50, CI 0.30-0.84) was inversely associated with NB. | Birth characteristics such as low birthweight (<2,500 g), small and large-for-gestational age, gestation age <37 weeks and gestation age >40 weeks, and assisted reproductive technology were not associated with NB.

all_evidence.title: The effect of folic acid intake on congenital anomalies. A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: Specifically, children whose mothers received periconceptional folic acid supplementation had a 77% reduced risk of congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Congenital anomalies pose a significant challenge to global health and result in considerable morbidity and mortality in early childhood. | With the decline of other causes of death among children under five, the burden of congenital anomalies is rising, emphasizing the need for improved prenatal care, screening, and nutrition for pregnant women. | This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to estimate the pooled effect of folic acid intake on congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.key_finding: Specifically, children whose mothers received periconceptional folic acid supplementation had a 77% reduced risk of congenital anomalies.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 구체적으로 임신 전후에 엽산 보충을 받은 산모의 자녀는 선천기형 위험이 77% 낮았습니다.
all_evidence.population: With the decline of other causes of death among children under five, the burden of congenital anomalies is rising, emphasizing the need for improved prenatal care, screening, and nutrition for pregnant women. | We computed the pooled effect size with 95% confidence intervals for maternal folic acid intake on congenital anomalies using STATA version 17 and the DerSimonian and Laird random effects meta-analysis model. | According to the results of this systematic review and meta-analysis, maternal folic acid intake significantly lowers the incidence of congenital anomalies (odds ratio (OR), 0.23; confidence interval (CI), 0.16, 0.32).

all_evidence.title: The Impact of Minerals on Female Fertility: A Systematic Review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSIONS: This review highlights the crucial role of both mineral supplementation and serum mineral status in female fertility.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the multifaceted role of minerals in female fertility, focusing on key areas such as oocyte quality, ovulation, embryo development, oxidative stress, miscarriage, hormonal regulation, environmental exposure, and in-vitro fertilization (IVF) outcomes. | Relevant literature was sourced from multiple electronic databases, including PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library, using keywords related to minerals and female fertility. | The studies addressed various reproductive outcomes influenced by minerals: embryo development, oocyte quality, oxidative stress, miscarriage, hormonal regulation, IVF outcomes, environmental exposure, and minerals as biomarkers.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: This review highlights the crucial role of both mineral supplementation and serum mineral status in female fertility.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 리뷰는 여성 생식능력에서 미네랄 보충과 혈청 미네랄 상태가 모두 중요한 역할을 한다는 점을 강조합니다.
all_evidence.population: METHODS: A systematic review was conducted, focusing on randomized controlled trials (RCTs), prospective cohort studies, case-control studies, nested case-control, and observational studies examining mineral supplementation and nutrition in women planning pregnancy or utilizing assisted reproduction technologies (ARTs).

all_evidence.title: Vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy and maternal and neonatal outcomes: results from a quantitative umbrella meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: Vitamin D supplementation lowered the risk of GDM (RR = 0.68, 95%CI: 0.53 to 0.88), preeclampsia (RR = 0.62, 95%CI: 0.56 to 0.69), PTD (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.65 to 0.90), LBW (RR = 0.67, 95%CI: 0.54 to 0.84), SGA (RR = 0.73, 95%CI: 0.63 to 0.85), stillbirth (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.62 to 0.95), and neonatal mortality (RR = 0.58, 95%CI: 0.40 to 0.84), while also enhanced birth weight (SMD = 75.68, 95%CI: 48.99 to 102.36), birth length (SMD = 0.25, 95%CI: 0.18 to 0.33), and head circumference (SMD = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.06 to 0.23).
all_evidence.outcome: The outcomes included gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), preeclampsia, cesarean section, preterm delivery (PTD), low birth weight (LBW), small for gestational age (SGA), stillbirth, neonatal mortality, birth weight, birth length, and head circumference at birth. | Vitamin D supplementation lowered the risk of GDM (RR = 0.68, 95%CI: 0.53 to 0.88), preeclampsia (RR = 0.62, 95%CI: 0.56 to 0.69), PTD (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.65 to 0.90), LBW (RR = 0.67, 95%CI: 0.54 to 0.84), SGA (RR = 0.73, 95%CI: 0.63 to 0.85), stillbirth (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.62 to 0.95), and neonatal mortality (RR = 0.58, 95%CI: 0.40 to 0.84), while also enhanced birth weight (SMD = 75.68, 95%CI: 48.99 to 102.36), birth length (SMD = 0.25, 95%CI: 0.18 to 0.33), and head circumference (SMD = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.06 to 0.23). | CONCLUSIONS: Prenatal vitamin D supplementation may be associated with a lower risk of certain adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes and may improve birth anthropometric measurements.
all_evidence.key_finding: Vitamin D supplementation lowered the risk of GDM (RR = 0.68, 95%CI: 0.53 to 0.88), preeclampsia (RR = 0.62, 95%CI: 0.56 to 0.69), PTD (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.65 to 0.90), LBW (RR = 0.67, 95%CI: 0.54 to 0.84), SGA (RR = 0.73, 95%CI: 0.63 to 0.85), stillbirth (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.62 to 0.95), and neonatal mortality (RR = 0.58, 95%CI: 0.40 to 0.84), while also enhanced birth weight (SMD = 75.68, 95%CI: 48.99 to 102.36), birth length (SMD = 0.25, 95%CI: 0.18 to 0.33), and head circumference (SMD = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.06 to 0.23).
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: This umbrella meta-analysis aimed to examine the effect of prenatal vitamin D supplementation on maternal and neonatal outcomes. | The outcomes included gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), preeclampsia, cesarean section, preterm delivery (PTD), low birth weight (LBW), small for gestational age (SGA), stillbirth, neonatal mortality, birth weight, birth length, and head circumference at birth. | Vitamin D supplementation lowered the risk of GDM (RR = 0.68, 95%CI: 0.53 to 0.88), preeclampsia (RR = 0.62, 95%CI: 0.56 to 0.69), PTD (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.65 to 0.90), LBW (RR = 0.67, 95%CI: 0.54 to 0.84), SGA (RR = 0.73, 95%CI: 0.63 to 0.85), stillbirth (RR = 0.77, 95%CI: 0.62 to 0.95), and neonatal mortality (RR = 0.58, 95%CI: 0.40 to 0.84), while also enhanced birth weight (SMD = 75.68, 95%CI: 48.99 to 102.36), birth length (SMD = 0.25, 95%CI: 0.18 to 0.33), and head circumference (SMD = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.06 to 0.23).

all_evidence.title: Effects of Selenium Administration on Blood Lipids: A Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis of Experimental Human Studies.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: DATA ANALYSIS: Dose-response analysis indicated that selenium administration at and above 200 µg/day decreased HDL and LDL cholesterol and increased triglyceride levels.
all_evidence.outcome: CONTEXT: Overexposure to the essential trace element selenium has been associated with adverse metabolic and cardiovascular outcomes, hypertension, and diabetes. | The adverse effects of selenium were stronger in studies involving healthy participants as compared with unhealthy participants and pregnant females, in those having a longer duration of the intervention, particularly more than 3 months, and in European populations at selenium intake levels of above 300 µg/day. | CONCLUSIONS: In this dose-response meta-analysis of experimental human studies, an adverse effect of selenium administration on blood lipids at levels around or above the current upper level of intake was observed.
all_evidence.key_finding: DATA ANALYSIS: Dose-response analysis indicated that selenium administration at and above 200 µg/day decreased HDL and LDL cholesterol and increased triglyceride levels.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 자료 분석: 용량 반응 분석에서 셀레늄을 200 µg/day 이상 투여하면 HDL 및 LDL 콜레스테롤이 감소하고 중성지방 수치가 증가했습니다.
all_evidence.population: DATA EXTRACTION: A total of 27 eligible RCTs that enrolled healthy individuals, pregnant individuals, and participants with specific health conditions were identified and the relevant data was extracted. | The adverse effects of selenium were stronger in studies involving healthy participants as compared with unhealthy participants and pregnant females, in those having a longer duration of the intervention, particularly more than 3 months, and in European populations at selenium intake levels of above 300 µg/day.

all_evidence.title: Is antenatal or early-life vitamin D associated with eczema or food allergy in childhood? A systematic review.
all_evidence.venue: Clinical and experimental allergy : journal of the British Society for Allergy and Clinical Immunology
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: Four RCTs of vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy showed no evidence of an effect on the incidence of eczema (pooled odds ratio [OR] = 0.85; 0.67-1.08, I2  = 6.7%, n = 2074).
all_evidence.outcome: DESIGN: A systematic review and meta-analyses were conducted to synthesize the published literature.

all_evidence.title: Evaluation of oral silymarin formulation efficacy in prevention of doxorubicin induced hepatotoxicity in patients with non-metastatic breast cancer.
all_evidence.venue: Journal of oncology pharmacy practice : official publication of the International Society of Oncology Pharmacy Practitioners
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: Moreover, the serum levels of aspartate aminotransferase (p = 0.015) and alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.004) at 6-week intervals, and the serum level of alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.002) at 9-week intervals were significantly lower in the silymarin group.ConclusionOral formulation of silymarin 420 mg/day for 63 days significantly prevented hepatotoxicity caused by doxorubicin in patients with non-metastatic breast cancer mostly based on liver ultrasonography but not laboratory parameters.
all_evidence.outcome: IntroductionChemotherapy-induced hepatotoxicity is a common complication in breast cancer patients, especially with doxorubicin-containing regimens. | Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties of silymarin, a polyphenolic flavonoid extract derived from Silybum marianum, may be useful in preventing chemotherapy-induced hepatotoxicity. | This study evaluated the effect of oral silymarin for preventing doxorubicin induced hepatotoxicity in non-metastatic breast cancer patients.MethodsIn this triple-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial, 50 patients with non-metastatic breast cancer were assigned to receive either 140 mg silymarin tablets or the placebo three times daily for 63 days and were evaluated for liver function test before the study and at the end of each chemotherapy cycle (every 3 weeks) for 4 cycles.
all_evidence.key_finding: Moreover, the serum levels of aspartate aminotransferase (p = 0.015) and alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.004) at 6-week intervals, and the serum level of alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.002) at 9-week intervals were significantly lower in the silymarin group.ConclusionOral formulation of silymarin 420 mg/day for 63 days significantly prevented hepatotoxicity caused by doxorubicin in patients with non-metastatic breast cancer mostly based on liver ultrasonography but not laboratory parameters.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: RESULTS: Meta-analysis indicated that microbial therapies significantly reduced BMI (-0.37 kg/m2; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.46 to -0.28; P < 0.001), hepatic enzymes (ALT, -6.9 U/L [95%CI, -9.4 to -4.3]; AST, -4.6 U/L [95%CI, -6.6 to -2.7]; γ-GT, -7.9 U/L [95%CI, -11.4 to -4.4]; P < 0.001), serum cholesterol (-10.1 mg/dL 95%CI, -13.6 to -6.6; P < 0.001), LDL-c (-4.5 mg/dL; 95%CI, -8.9 to -0.17; P < 0.001), and TAG (-10.1 mg/dL; 95%CI, -18.0 to -2.3; P < 0.001), but not inflammation (TNF-α, -2.0 ng/mL; [95%CI, -4.7 to 0.61]; CRP, -0.74 mg/L [95%CI, -1.9 to 0.37]).
all_evidence.outcome: DATA EXTRACTION: Basic population characteristics, the primary variables of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) (utilized for NAFLD diagnosis), and the secondary variables of body mass index (BMI), gamma-glutamyl transferase (γ-GT), tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α), C-reactive protein (CRP), total cholesterol, high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-c), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-c), and triglyceridges (TAG) were extracted.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Meta-analysis indicated that microbial therapies significantly reduced BMI (-0.37 kg/m2; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.46 to -0.28; P < 0.001), hepatic enzymes (ALT, -6.9 U/L [95%CI, -9.4 to -4.3]; AST, -4.6 U/L [95%CI, -6.6 to -2.7]; γ-GT, -7.9 U/L [95%CI, -11.4 to -4.4]; P < 0.001), serum cholesterol (-10.1 mg/dL 95%CI, -13.6 to -6.6; P < 0.001), LDL-c (-4.5 mg/dL; 95%CI, -8.9 to -0.17; P < 0.001), and TAG (-10.1 mg/dL; 95%CI, -18.0 to -2.3; P < 0.001), but not inflammation (TNF-α, -2.0 ng/mL; [95%CI, -4.7 to 0.61]; CRP, -0.74 mg/L [95%CI, -1.9 to 0.37]).

all_evidence.title: The efficacy of gut microbiota-regulating drugs on metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_18: CONCLUSIONS: Probiotics and synbiotics significantly improve liver enzymes and hepatic steatosis in patients with MASLD.
all_evidence.outcome: Relative to placebo, reductions in alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels were observed with probiotics (Mean Difference (MD): -7.51, 95% credible intervals (CI) [-12.36 to -2.66]), prebiotics (MD: -13.64, 95% CI [-27.07 to -0.22]) and antibiotics (MD: -24.30, 95% CI [-47.02 to -1.58]). | Probiotics (MD: -6.42, 95% CI [-11.91 to -0.92]) and synbiotics (MD: -13.13, 95% CI [-20.82 to -5.45]) were both associated with a reduction in aspartate aminotransferase (AST) levels compared to placebo.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Probiotics and synbiotics significantly improve liver enzymes and hepatic steatosis in patients with MASLD.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 프로바이오틱스와 신바이오틱스는 MASLD 환자의 간효소와 지방간을 유의하게 개선한다.
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: Currently, effective drugs for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) are limited, with treatment primarily focusing on diet and exercise. | Liver enzymes and hepatic steatosis were taken as the primary outcome and were analyzed by random-effects, Bayesian network meta-analyses. | CONCLUSIONS: Probiotics and synbiotics significantly improve liver enzymes and hepatic steatosis in patients with MASLD.

all_evidence.title: Traditional Chinese medicine for type 2 diabetes with metabolic-associated steatotic liver disease: unified effects and design thresholds.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: CONCLUSION: In adults with T2DM and MASLD, add-on trials show directionally favorable pooled biochemical/metabolic changes after unified effect harmonization, but uncertainty remains substantial.
all_evidence.outcome: The prespecified primary endpoints maximizing cross-trial comparability were alanine aminotransferase (ALT), triglycerides (TG), Homeostatic Model Assessment of Insulin resistance (HOMA-IR), and controlled attenuation parameter (CAP); aspartate aminotransferase (AST) was retained for robustness.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: In adults with T2DM and MASLD, add-on trials show directionally favorable pooled biochemical/metabolic changes after unified effect harmonization, but uncertainty remains substantial.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 제2형 당뇨병과 MASLD 성인의 추가요법 시험은 효과 방향을 통일한 뒤 생화학·대사 지표의 통합 변화가 유리한 방향이지만 불확실성이 상당함을 보였다.
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: This study aims to reorganize randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and metabolic-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD; including legacy NAFLD) into a clinical evidence-anchored knowledge graph (KG) and harmonize effect semantics ("unified effects") to support endpoint- and design-aware evidence navigation. | Metabolic endpoints were synthesized at the 12-week timepoint, while imaging endpoints (CAP and liver stiffness measurement [LSM]) were synthesized within a prespecified 8- to 24-week window.

all_evidence.title: Traditional Chinese Medicines for Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: A Mixed-Method Systematic Review.

all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: The current study suggests that antioxidant and probiotic/symbiotic/prebiotic supplements may be a promising regimen for NAFLD patients.

all_evidence.outcome: Results showed that microbiome-targeted therapies could significantly reduce levels of alanine aminotransferase (ALT; effect size [ES], -10.21; 95% confidence interval [CI], -13.29, -7.14; P < 0.001), aspartate aminotransferase (AST; ES, -8.86; 95%CI, -11.39, -6.32; P < 0.001), and γ-glutamyltransferase (ES, -5.56; 95%CI, -7.92, -3.31; P < 0.001) in patients with NAFLD.
all_evidence.key_finding: Prebiotics had no significant effects on AST and ALT levels (ES, -2.96; 95%CI, -8.12, 2.18, P = 0.259; and ES, -4.69; 95%CI, -13.53, 4.15, P = 0.299, respectively).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 프리바이오틱은 AST와 ALT 수치에 유의한 영향을 주지 않았다(각각 ES -2.96, 95% CI -8.12~2.18, P=0.259; ES -4.69, 95% CI -13.53~4.15, P=0.299).
all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Meta-Analysis|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review
all_evidence.population: CONTEXT: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is considered the leading cause of chronic liver disease worldwide. | OBJECTIVES: This umbrella study summarizes the results of meta-analyses investigating the effects of probiotics, prebiotics, and synbiotics on liver enzymes in the NAFLD population. | CONCLUSION: Gut microbiome-targeted therapies could be a promising therapeutic approach in the improvement of hepatic damage in patients with NAFLD.

evidence.title: The effects of different parenteral nutrition lipid formulations on clinical and laboratory endpoints in patients receiving home parenteral nutrition: A systematic review.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_17: Although LE containing olive +/or fish oil show promise with regards to liver function and blood and cell fatty acid profiles, further studies are needed before drawing definitive conclusions on the clinical value of these emulsions.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Home parenteral nutrition (HPN) is a life-sustaining therapy for individuals with intestinal failure in a community setting. | Long-term use of HPN can lead to a number of adverse health outcomes including the development of metabolic bone disease, intestinal failure associated liver disease and poor quality of life but whether, and how, the composition of HPN solutions contributes to these health sequelae is poorly understood. | In general, LE were well tolerated with no significant adverse effects.
evidence.key_finding: Although LE containing olive +/or fish oil show promise with regards to liver function and blood and cell fatty acid profiles, further studies are needed before drawing definitive conclusions on the clinical value of these emulsions.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 올리브유 및/또는 어유를 포함한 지질 유제는 간기능과 혈액·세포 지방산 지표에서 가능성을 보이지만, 이 유제의 임상적 가치를 확정하려면 추가 연구가 필요하다.
evidence.population: Long-term use of HPN can lead to a number of adverse health outcomes including the development of metabolic bone disease, intestinal failure associated liver disease and poor quality of life but whether, and how, the composition of HPN solutions contributes to these health sequelae is poorly understood. | LE containing olive +/or fish oil were associated with a lower ω-6:ω-3 fatty acid ratio, positive reductions in markers of liver function, and changes in blood and cell fatty acid profiles. | Although LE containing olive +/or fish oil show promise with regards to liver function and blood and cell fatty acid profiles, further studies are needed before drawing definitive conclusions on the clinical value of these emulsions.

evidence.title: Nutritional supplementation for nonalcohol-related fatty liver disease: a network meta-analysis.
evidence.venue: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_30: AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: The evidence indicates considerable uncertainty about effects of nutritional supplementation compared to no additional intervention on all clinical outcomes for people with non-alcohol-related fatty liver disease.
evidence.outcome: NAFLD decreases life expectancy and increases risks of liver cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, and the requirement for liver transplantation. | We excluded randomised clinical trials in which participants had previously undergone liver transplantation. | During this follow-up period, clinical events related to NAFLD such as mortality, liver cirrhosis, liver decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma, and liver-related mortality were sparse.
evidence.key_finding: AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: The evidence indicates considerable uncertainty about effects of nutritional supplementation compared to no additional intervention on all clinical outcomes for people with non-alcohol-related fatty liver disease.

evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review|Network Meta-Analysis

evidence.title: Efficacy of resveratrol supplementation on liver enzymes in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: The overall results indicated that resveratrol supplementation did not affect liver enzymes in patients with NAFLD.
evidence.outcome: The aim of this systematic review was to summarize evidence of the effects of resveratrol supplementation on alanine aminotransferase (ALT), and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) levels in patients with NAFLD by performing a meta-analysis of RCTs.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: The overall results indicated that resveratrol supplementation did not affect liver enzymes in patients with NAFLD.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 전체 결과에서 레스베라트롤 보충은 NAFLD 환자의 간 효소에 영향을 미치지 않았습니다.
evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: Randomized clinical trials (RCTs) examining the effects of resveratrol supplementation on liver enzymes in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) have reported conflicting results. | Random effect models were used to estimate liver enzymes changes between resveratrol supplementation and control groups by evaluating the weighted mean differences (WMD) with 95 % confidence intervals (CIs). | CONCLUSIONS: The overall results indicated that resveratrol supplementation did not affect liver enzymes in patients with NAFLD.

evidence.title: Traditional Chinese Medicines for Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: A Mixed-Method Systematic Review.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: CONCLUSIONS: TCM formulations may provide symptomatic and metabolic benefits for MASLD with acceptable safety and identifiable core herbs; however, evidence certainty is very low due to pervasive poor methodological quality of included RCTs, which severely undermines confidence in findings.
evidence.outcome: TCM-related adverse events (mainly diarrhea and gastrointestinal discomfort) were mild and rare; 63.2% of studies reported no adverse events.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: TCM formulations may provide symptomatic and metabolic benefits for MASLD with acceptable safety and identifiable core herbs; however, evidence certainty is very low due to pervasive poor methodological quality of included RCTs, which severely undermines confidence in findings.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: TCM 제제는 MASLD에서 수용 가능한 안전성과 확인 가능한 핵심 약초를 바탕으로 증상·대사 이득을 줄 수 있지만, 포함된 무작위시험의 전반적인 방법론적 질이 낮아 근거 확실성이 매우 낮고 결과에 대한 신뢰가 크게 떨어진다.
evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: This mixed-method systematic review evaluated the efficacy and safety of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and identified core TCM herbs/compatibility regimens. | TCM significantly improved TCM Symptom Score, clinical effective rate, liver controlled attenuation parameter (CAP), liver function (ALT, AST, GGT), lipid metabolism (TC, TG, LDL-C) and reduced BMI, with no benefit for HDL-C.

evidence.title: The effects of different parenteral nutrition lipid formulations on clinical and laboratory endpoints in patients receiving home parenteral nutrition: A systematic review.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_17: Although LE containing olive +/or fish oil show promise with regards to liver function and blood and cell fatty acid profiles, further studies are needed before drawing definitive conclusions on the clinical value of these emulsions.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Home parenteral nutrition (HPN) is a life-sustaining therapy for individuals with intestinal failure in a community setting. | Long-term use of HPN can lead to a number of adverse health outcomes including the development of metabolic bone disease, intestinal failure associated liver disease and poor quality of life but whether, and how, the composition of HPN solutions contributes to these health sequelae is poorly understood. | In general, LE were well tolerated with no significant adverse effects.
evidence.key_finding: Although LE containing olive +/or fish oil show promise with regards to liver function and blood and cell fatty acid profiles, further studies are needed before drawing definitive conclusions on the clinical value of these emulsions.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 올리브유 및/또는 어유를 포함한 지질 유제는 간기능과 혈액·세포 지방산 지표에서 가능성을 보이지만, 이 유제의 임상적 가치를 확정하려면 추가 연구가 필요하다.
evidence.population: Long-term use of HPN can lead to a number of adverse health outcomes including the development of metabolic bone disease, intestinal failure associated liver disease and poor quality of life but whether, and how, the composition of HPN solutions contributes to these health sequelae is poorly understood. | LE containing olive +/or fish oil were associated with a lower ω-6:ω-3 fatty acid ratio, positive reductions in markers of liver function, and changes in blood and cell fatty acid profiles. | Although LE containing olive +/or fish oil show promise with regards to liver function and blood and cell fatty acid profiles, further studies are needed before drawing definitive conclusions on the clinical value of these emulsions.

evidence.title: Nutritional supplementation for nonalcohol-related fatty liver disease: a network meta-analysis.
evidence.venue: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews

evidence.outcome: NAFLD decreases life expectancy and increases risks of liver cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, and the requirement for liver transplantation. | We excluded randomised clinical trials in which participants had previously undergone liver transplantation. | During this follow-up period, clinical events related to NAFLD such as mortality, liver cirrhosis, liver decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma, and liver-related mortality were sparse.

all_evidence.outcome: IntroductionChemotherapy-induced hepatotoxicity is a common complication in breast cancer patients, especially with doxorubicin-containing regimens. | Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties of silymarin, a polyphenolic flavonoid extract derived from Silybum marianum, may be useful in preventing chemotherapy-induced hepatotoxicity. | This study evaluated the effect of oral silymarin for preventing doxorubicin induced hepatotoxicity in non-metastatic breast cancer patients.MethodsIn this triple-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial, 50 patients with non-metastatic breast cancer were assigned to receive either 140 mg silymarin tablets or the placebo three times daily for 63 days and were evaluated for liver function test before the study and at the end of each chemotherapy cycle (every 3 weeks) for 4 cycles.
all_evidence.key_finding: Moreover, the serum levels of aspartate aminotransferase (p = 0.015) and alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.004) at 6-week intervals, and the serum level of alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.002) at 9-week intervals were significantly lower in the silymarin group.ConclusionOral formulation of silymarin 420 mg/day for 63 days significantly prevented hepatotoxicity caused by doxorubicin in patients with non-metastatic breast cancer mostly based on liver ultrasonography but not laboratory parameters.

all_evidence.title: Prebiotic and probiotic treatment of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: RESULTS: Meta-analysis indicated that microbial therapies significantly reduced BMI (-0.37 kg/m2; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.46 to -0.28; P < 0.001), hepatic enzymes (ALT, -6.9 U/L [95%CI, -9.4 to -4.3]; AST, -4.6 U/L [95%CI, -6.6 to -2.7]; γ-GT, -7.9 U/L [95%CI, -11.4 to -4.4]; P < 0.001), serum cholesterol (-10.1 mg/dL 95%CI, -13.6 to -6.6; P < 0.001), LDL-c (-4.5 mg/dL; 95%CI, -8.9 to -0.17; P < 0.001), and TAG (-10.1 mg/dL; 95%CI, -18.0 to -2.3; P < 0.001), but not inflammation (TNF-α, -2.0 ng/mL; [95%CI, -4.7 to 0.61]; CRP, -0.74 mg/L [95%CI, -1.9 to 0.37]).
all_evidence.outcome: DATA EXTRACTION: Basic population characteristics, the primary variables of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) (utilized for NAFLD diagnosis), and the secondary variables of body mass index (BMI), gamma-glutamyl transferase (γ-GT), tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α), C-reactive protein (CRP), total cholesterol, high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-c), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-c), and triglyceridges (TAG) were extracted.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Meta-analysis indicated that microbial therapies significantly reduced BMI (-0.37 kg/m2; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.46 to -0.28; P < 0.001), hepatic enzymes (ALT, -6.9 U/L [95%CI, -9.4 to -4.3]; AST, -4.6 U/L [95%CI, -6.6 to -2.7]; γ-GT, -7.9 U/L [95%CI, -11.4 to -4.4]; P < 0.001), serum cholesterol (-10.1 mg/dL 95%CI, -13.6 to -6.6; P < 0.001), LDL-c (-4.5 mg/dL; 95%CI, -8.9 to -0.17; P < 0.001), and TAG (-10.1 mg/dL; 95%CI, -18.0 to -2.3; P < 0.001), but not inflammation (TNF-α, -2.0 ng/mL; [95%CI, -4.7 to 0.61]; CRP, -0.74 mg/L [95%CI, -1.9 to 0.37]).
all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Meta-Analysis|Research Support, U.S. Gov't, Non-P.H.S.|Systematic Review
all_evidence.population: CONTEXT: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is a highly prevalent and underdiagnosed comorbidity of many chronic diseases that is associated with altered intestinal bacterial communities. | RESULTS: Meta-analysis indicated that microbial therapies significantly reduced BMI (-0.37 kg/m2; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.46 to -0.28; P < 0.001), hepatic enzymes (ALT, -6.9 U/L [95%CI, -9.4 to -4.3]; AST, -4.6 U/L [95%CI, -6.6 to -2.7]; γ-GT, -7.9 U/L [95%CI, -11.4 to -4.4]; P < 0.001), serum cholesterol (-10.1 mg/dL 95%CI, -13.6 to -6.6; P < 0.001), LDL-c (-4.5 mg/dL; 95%CI, -8.9 to -0.17; P < 0.001), and TAG (-10.1 mg/dL; 95%CI, -18.0 to -2.3; P < 0.001), but not inflammation (TNF-α, -2.0 ng/mL; [95%CI, -4.7 to 0.61]; CRP, -0.74 mg/L [95%CI, -1.9 to 0.37]). | Subgroup analysis by treatment category indicated similar effects of prebiotics and probiotics on BMI and liver enzymes but not total cholesterol, HDL-c, and LDL-c.

all_evidence.title: The efficacy of gut microbiota-regulating drugs on metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_18: CONCLUSIONS: Probiotics and synbiotics significantly improve liver enzymes and hepatic steatosis in patients with MASLD.
all_evidence.outcome: Relative to placebo, reductions in alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels were observed with probiotics (Mean Difference (MD): -7.51, 95% credible intervals (CI) [-12.36 to -2.66]), prebiotics (MD: -13.64, 95% CI [-27.07 to -0.22]) and antibiotics (MD: -24.30, 95% CI [-47.02 to -1.58]). | Probiotics (MD: -6.42, 95% CI [-11.91 to -0.92]) and synbiotics (MD: -13.13, 95% CI [-20.82 to -5.45]) were both associated with a reduction in aspartate aminotransferase (AST) levels compared to placebo.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Probiotics and synbiotics significantly improve liver enzymes and hepatic steatosis in patients with MASLD.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 프로바이오틱스와 신바이오틱스는 MASLD 환자의 간효소와 지방간을 유의하게 개선한다.
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: Currently, effective drugs for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) are limited, with treatment primarily focusing on diet and exercise. | Liver enzymes and hepatic steatosis were taken as the primary outcome and were analyzed by random-effects, Bayesian network meta-analyses. | CONCLUSIONS: Probiotics and synbiotics significantly improve liver enzymes and hepatic steatosis in patients with MASLD.

all_evidence.title: Traditional Chinese medicine for type 2 diabetes with metabolic-associated steatotic liver disease: unified effects and design thresholds.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: CONCLUSION: In adults with T2DM and MASLD, add-on trials show directionally favorable pooled biochemical/metabolic changes after unified effect harmonization, but uncertainty remains substantial.
all_evidence.outcome: The prespecified primary endpoints maximizing cross-trial comparability were alanine aminotransferase (ALT), triglycerides (TG), Homeostatic Model Assessment of Insulin resistance (HOMA-IR), and controlled attenuation parameter (CAP); aspartate aminotransferase (AST) was retained for robustness.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: In adults with T2DM and MASLD, add-on trials show directionally favorable pooled biochemical/metabolic changes after unified effect harmonization, but uncertainty remains substantial.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 제2형 당뇨병과 MASLD 성인의 추가요법 시험은 효과 방향을 통일한 뒤 생화학·대사 지표의 통합 변화가 유리한 방향이지만 불확실성이 상당함을 보였다.
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: This study aims to reorganize randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and metabolic-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD; including legacy NAFLD) into a clinical evidence-anchored knowledge graph (KG) and harmonize effect semantics ("unified effects") to support endpoint- and design-aware evidence navigation. | Metabolic endpoints were synthesized at the 12-week timepoint, while imaging endpoints (CAP and liver stiffness measurement [LSM]) were synthesized within a prespecified 8- to 24-week window.

all_evidence.title: Traditional Chinese Medicines for Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: A Mixed-Method Systematic Review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: CONCLUSIONS: TCM formulations may provide symptomatic and metabolic benefits for MASLD with acceptable safety and identifiable core herbs; however, evidence certainty is very low due to pervasive poor methodological quality of included RCTs, which severely undermines confidence in findings.
all_evidence.outcome: TCM-related adverse events (mainly diarrhea and gastrointestinal discomfort) were mild and rare; 63.2% of studies reported no adverse events.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: TCM formulations may provide symptomatic and metabolic benefits for MASLD with acceptable safety and identifiable core herbs; however, evidence certainty is very low due to pervasive poor methodological quality of included RCTs, which severely undermines confidence in findings.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: TCM 제제는 MASLD에서 수용 가능한 안전성과 확인 가능한 핵심 약초를 바탕으로 증상·대사 이득을 줄 수 있지만, 포함된 무작위시험의 전반적인 방법론적 질이 낮아 근거 확실성이 매우 낮고 결과에 대한 신뢰가 크게 떨어진다.
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: This mixed-method systematic review evaluated the efficacy and safety of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and identified core TCM herbs/compatibility regimens. | TCM significantly improved TCM Symptom Score, clinical effective rate, liver controlled attenuation parameter (CAP), liver function (ALT, AST, GGT), lipid metabolism (TC, TG, LDL-C) and reduced BMI, with no benefit for HDL-C.

all_evidence.title: The effectiveness and safety of Yi Guan Jian decoction in the treatment of primary liver cancer: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: Meta-analysis showed that YGJ or its modified versions, combined with Western medical supportive treatments, significantly increased treatment effectiveness (OR = 1.84, 95% CI: 1.32-2.58), improved Karnofsky performance status score (MD = 7.00, 95% CI: 4.80-9.21), decreased serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) (SMD = -0.36, 95% CI: -0.58 to -0.14), improved TCM syndrome scores (MD = -3.10, 95% CI: -3.78 to -2.42), reduced total bilirubin (MD = -1.52, 95% CI: -2.25 to -0.78), and lowered gastrointestinal adverse reactions (OR = 0.53, 95% CI: 0.33-0.84).
all_evidence.outcome: Meta-analysis showed that YGJ or its modified versions, combined with Western medical supportive treatments, significantly increased treatment effectiveness (OR = 1.84, 95% CI: 1.32-2.58), improved Karnofsky performance status score (MD = 7.00, 95% CI: 4.80-9.21), decreased serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) (SMD = -0.36, 95% CI: -0.58 to -0.14), improved TCM syndrome scores (MD = -3.10, 95% CI: -3.78 to -2.42), reduced total bilirubin (MD = -1.52, 95% CI: -2.25 to -0.78), and lowered gastrointestinal adverse reactions (OR = 0.53, 95% CI: 0.33-0.84). | CONCLUSION: The combination of YGJ or its modified versions with modern medical therapies significantly enhances treatment effectiveness, Karnofsky performance status scores, and TCM syndrome scores, reduces AFP levels, and decreases gastrointestinal adverse reactions compared to modern medical therapies alone.
all_evidence.key_finding: Meta-analysis showed that YGJ or its modified versions, combined with Western medical supportive treatments, significantly increased treatment effectiveness (OR = 1.84, 95% CI: 1.32-2.58), improved Karnofsky performance status score (MD = 7.00, 95% CI: 4.80-9.21), decreased serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) (SMD = -0.36, 95% CI: -0.58 to -0.14), improved TCM syndrome scores (MD = -3.10, 95% CI: -3.78 to -2.42), reduced total bilirubin (MD = -1.52, 95% CI: -2.25 to -0.78), and lowered gastrointestinal adverse reactions (OR = 0.53, 95% CI: 0.33-0.84).

all_evidence.title: Functional foods and dietary supplements in the management of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: CONCLUSION: The current study suggests that antioxidant and probiotic/symbiotic/prebiotic supplements may be a promising regimen for NAFLD patients.
all_evidence.outcome: The primary outcomes were liver-related measures, such as alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), and hepatic fibrosis and steatosis, while the secondary outcomes included body mass index (BMI), waist circumference (WC), triacylglyceride (TG), total cholesterol (TC), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), and high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C).
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: The current study suggests that antioxidant and probiotic/symbiotic/prebiotic supplements may be a promising regimen for NAFLD patients.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 연구는 항산화제와 프로바이오틱·신바이오틱·프리바이오틱 보충제가 비알코올성 지방간 환자에게 유망한 요법일 수 있음을 시사한다.
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVE: In this systematic review and meta-analysis, we aimed to clarify the overall effects of functional foods and dietary supplements in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) patients. | The primary outcomes were liver-related measures, such as alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), and hepatic fibrosis and steatosis, while the secondary outcomes included body mass index (BMI), waist circumference (WC), triacylglyceride (TG), total cholesterol (TC), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), and high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C). | Additionally, vitamin D had no significant effect on BMI, liver transaminase, and serum lipids, while whole grain could reduce ALT and AST but did not affect serum lipid levels.

all_evidence.title: The impact of gut microbiome-targeted therapy on liver enzymes in patients with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease: an umbrella meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: Prebiotics had no significant effects on AST and ALT levels (ES, -2.96; 95%CI, -8.12, 2.18, P = 0.259; and ES, -4.69; 95%CI, -13.53, 4.15, P = 0.299, respectively).
all_evidence.outcome: Results showed that microbiome-targeted therapies could significantly reduce levels of alanine aminotransferase (ALT; effect size [ES], -10.21; 95% confidence interval [CI], -13.29, -7.14; P < 0.001), aspartate aminotransferase (AST; ES, -8.86; 95%CI, -11.39, -6.32; P < 0.001), and γ-glutamyltransferase (ES, -5.56; 95%CI, -7.92, -3.31; P < 0.001) in patients with NAFLD.
all_evidence.key_finding: Prebiotics had no significant effects on AST and ALT levels (ES, -2.96; 95%CI, -8.12, 2.18, P = 0.259; and ES, -4.69; 95%CI, -13.53, 4.15, P = 0.299, respectively).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 프리바이오틱은 AST와 ALT 수치에 유의한 영향을 주지 않았다(각각 ES -2.96, 95% CI -8.12~2.18, P=0.259; ES -4.69, 95% CI -13.53~4.15, P=0.299).

all_evidence.population: CONTEXT: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is considered the leading cause of chronic liver disease worldwide. | OBJECTIVES: This umbrella study summarizes the results of meta-analyses investigating the effects of probiotics, prebiotics, and synbiotics on liver enzymes in the NAFLD population. | CONCLUSION: Gut microbiome-targeted therapies could be a promising therapeutic approach in the improvement of hepatic damage in patients with NAFLD.

all_evidence.title: Curcumin effects on glycaemic indices, lipid profile, blood pressure, inflammatory markers and anthropometric measurements of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease patients: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: There was no significant change in HbA1C, plasma insulin, QUICKI, HDL, SBP, DBP, CRP, TNF-α and WC after curcumin therapy.
all_evidence.outcome: There are several limitations in the studies that were included, for instance, the results are weakened substantially by potential bias or failure to account for potential adulteration (with pharmaceuticals) or contamination (with other herbs) of the curcumin supplements that were tested. | Furthermore, because of the failure to conduct independent biochemical assessment of the turmeric/curcumin product used in most studies as well as potential sources of bias, results should be interpreted with caution.
all_evidence.key_finding: There was no significant change in HbA1C, plasma insulin, QUICKI, HDL, SBP, DBP, CRP, TNF-α and WC after curcumin therapy.

evidence.title: Phase 1 study of the effect of icosapent ethyl on warfarin pharmacokinetic and anticoagulation parameters.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: IPE 4 g/day did not significantly change the single-dose AUC(0-∞) or C(max) of R- and S-warfarin or the anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin when co-administered as racemic warfarin at 25 mg.
evidence.outcome: EPA, the active metabolite of IPE, is mainly metabolized via β-oxidation, and studies suggest that omega-3 fatty acids such as EPA may have antithrombotic effects. | The objective of this study was to evaluate the effect of IPE on the pharmacokinetic and anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin, a substrate of cytochrome P450 2C9-mediated metabolism. | Primary pharmacokinetic end points were area under the concentration-versus-time curve from zero to infinity (AUC(0-∞)) and maximum plasma concentration (C(max)) for R- and S-warfarin; pharmacodynamic end points were area under the international normalized ratio (INR) effect-time curve after the warfarin dose (AUC(INR)) and maximum INR (INR(max)).
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: IPE 4 g/day did not significantly change the single-dose AUC(0-∞) or C(max) of R- and S-warfarin or the anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin when co-administered as racemic warfarin at 25 mg.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이코사펜트 에틸(IPE) 4 g/day를 라세미체 와파린 25 mg과 병용해도 R·S-와파린의 단회 투여 AUC(0-∞) 또는 Cmax, 그리고 와파린의 항응고 약력학은 유의하게 변하지 않았습니다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase I|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
evidence.population: The objective of this study was to evaluate the effect of IPE on the pharmacokinetic and anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin, a substrate of cytochrome P450 2C9-mediated metabolism. | METHODS: Healthy adults received oral warfarin (25 mg) on day 1, oral IPE (4 g/day) on days 8-35, and co-administration on Day 29. | Primary pharmacokinetic end points were area under the concentration-versus-time curve from zero to infinity (AUC(0-∞)) and maximum plasma concentration (C(max)) for R- and S-warfarin; pharmacodynamic end points were area under the international normalized ratio (INR) effect-time curve after the warfarin dose (AUC(INR)) and maximum INR (INR(max)).

evidence.title: One Milligram Versus Two Milligram Intramuscular Vitamin K to Prevent Late-Onset Hemorrhagic Disease in Young Infants: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_14: CONCLUSION: There was no difference in PIVKA II levels between neonates receiving 1 mg or 2 mg vitamin K IM suggesting a similar risk for late-onset VKDB in both groups.
evidence.outcome: OBJECTIVE: To compare the efficacy of a standard dose (1 mg) with 2 mg vitamin K administered by intramuscular (IM) route in reducing subclinical late-onset vitamin K deficiency bleeding (VKDB) assessed using serum protein induced by vitamin K absence (PIVKA II) levels. | Neonates delivered to mothers receiving antiepileptics, anti-tuberculous drugs, or warfarin, and those with a family history of bleeding disorder were excluded.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: There was no difference in PIVKA II levels between neonates receiving 1 mg or 2 mg vitamin K IM suggesting a similar risk for late-onset VKDB in both groups.

all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Traditional Chinese medicine injection for Activating Blood Circulation (TCMi-ABC), which exhibits comparable anticoagulant and antiplatelet effects, is commonly used as an adjuvant treatment for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) in China. | There was no significant difference in the incidence of adverse events between the two groups (P > 0.05). | The GRADE evidence quality classification indicated that the evidence for in-hospital mortality, malignant arrhythmia, and adverse events was of moderate quality, while the evidence for LVEF was of low quality.
all_evidence.key_finding: The meta-analysis results demonstrated that the combined application of TCMi-ABC, compared with conventional western medicine treatment alone, significantly reduced in-hospital mortality in AMI patients [RR= 0.41, 95% CI (0.29, 0.59), P < 0.05], decreased the incidence of malignant arrhythmia [RR= 0.40, 95% CI (0.26, 0.61), P < 0.05], and increased left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) [MD= 5.53, 95% CI (3.81, 7.26), P < 0.05].

all_evidence.title: Managing Anticoagulation and Dual Antiplatelet Therapy in Patients with Active Bleed or Upcoming Procedure: A Scoping Review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: Emergent anticoagulation reversal treatment is available for both warfarin (i.e., prothrombin complex concentrate, phytonadione) and DOACs (i.e., idarucizumab for dabigatran reversal; andexanet alfa for apixaban and rivaroxaban reversal).
all_evidence.outcome: INTRODUCTION: The aim of this paper is to provide primary care providers and hospitalists with up-to-date guidance surrounding the management of anticoagulation and antiplatelet agents in periprocedural settings and when unexpected bleeding complications arise. | RESULTS: For direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) and vitamin K agonists (VKAs), a patient's risk for clot and procedural risk of bleeding should be assessed. | Generally, patients considered at high risk for venous thromboembolism (VTE) should be bridged, patients at low risk should forgo bridging therapy, and patients in the intermediate range should be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
all_evidence.key_finding: Emergent anticoagulation reversal treatment is available for both warfarin (i.e., prothrombin complex concentrate, phytonadione) and DOACs (i.e., idarucizumab for dabigatran reversal; andexanet alfa for apixaban and rivaroxaban reversal).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 응급 항응고 역전 치료는 와파린(예: 프로트롬빈 복합체 농축물, 피토메나디온)과 DOAC 모두에 사용할 수 있습니다(DOAC의 경우 다비가트란 역전에 이다루시주맙, 아픽사반과 리바록사반 역전에 안덱사넷 알파).

evidence.title: Phase 1 study of the effect of icosapent ethyl on warfarin pharmacokinetic and anticoagulation parameters.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: IPE 4 g/day did not significantly change the single-dose AUC(0-∞) or C(max) of R- and S-warfarin or the anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin when co-administered as racemic warfarin at 25 mg.
evidence.outcome: EPA, the active metabolite of IPE, is mainly metabolized via β-oxidation, and studies suggest that omega-3 fatty acids such as EPA may have antithrombotic effects. | The objective of this study was to evaluate the effect of IPE on the pharmacokinetic and anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin, a substrate of cytochrome P450 2C9-mediated metabolism. | Primary pharmacokinetic end points were area under the concentration-versus-time curve from zero to infinity (AUC(0-∞)) and maximum plasma concentration (C(max)) for R- and S-warfarin; pharmacodynamic end points were area under the international normalized ratio (INR) effect-time curve after the warfarin dose (AUC(INR)) and maximum INR (INR(max)).
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: IPE 4 g/day did not significantly change the single-dose AUC(0-∞) or C(max) of R- and S-warfarin or the anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin when co-administered as racemic warfarin at 25 mg.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이코사펜트 에틸(IPE) 4 g/day를 라세미체 와파린 25 mg과 병용해도 R·S-와파린의 단회 투여 AUC(0-∞) 또는 Cmax, 그리고 와파린의 항응고 약력학은 유의하게 변하지 않았습니다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase I|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
evidence.population: The objective of this study was to evaluate the effect of IPE on the pharmacokinetic and anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin, a substrate of cytochrome P450 2C9-mediated metabolism. | METHODS: Healthy adults received oral warfarin (25 mg) on day 1, oral IPE (4 g/day) on days 8-35, and co-administration on Day 29. | Primary pharmacokinetic end points were area under the concentration-versus-time curve from zero to infinity (AUC(0-∞)) and maximum plasma concentration (C(max)) for R- and S-warfarin; pharmacodynamic end points were area under the international normalized ratio (INR) effect-time curve after the warfarin dose (AUC(INR)) and maximum INR (INR(max)).

evidence.title: One Milligram Versus Two Milligram Intramuscular Vitamin K to Prevent Late-Onset Hemorrhagic Disease in Young Infants: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_14: CONCLUSION: There was no difference in PIVKA II levels between neonates receiving 1 mg or 2 mg vitamin K IM suggesting a similar risk for late-onset VKDB in both groups.
evidence.outcome: OBJECTIVE: To compare the efficacy of a standard dose (1 mg) with 2 mg vitamin K administered by intramuscular (IM) route in reducing subclinical late-onset vitamin K deficiency bleeding (VKDB) assessed using serum protein induced by vitamin K absence (PIVKA II) levels. | Neonates delivered to mothers receiving antiepileptics, anti-tuberculous drugs, or warfarin, and those with a family history of bleeding disorder were excluded.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: There was no difference in PIVKA II levels between neonates receiving 1 mg or 2 mg vitamin K IM suggesting a similar risk for late-onset VKDB in both groups.

evidence.title: Impact of Vitamin K Administration on Elevated International Normalized Ratio in Chronic Liver Disease.
evidence.venue: Clinical and applied thrombosis/hemostasis : official journal of the International Academy of Clinical and Applied Thrombosis/Hemostasis
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: The administration of vitamin K in hospitalized patients with CLD resulted in minimal INR change, suggesting this intervention may not have the intended benefit of reducing bleeding risk.
evidence.outcome: However, vitamin K is commonly used to treat elevations in international normalized ratio (INR) in these patients with the intended benefit of reducing bleeding risk. | This retrospective, single-center cohort study aimed to evaluate the impact of vitamin K administration on INR in patients with CLD. | The primary outcome was the absolute change in INR from baseline to 24 to 48 h after vitamin K administration.
evidence.key_finding: The administration of vitamin K in hospitalized patients with CLD resulted in minimal INR change, suggesting this intervention may not have the intended benefit of reducing bleeding risk.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 만성 간질환 입원 환자에서 비타민 K 투여 후 INR 변화는 미미해, 출혈 위험 감소라는 의도한 이득이 없을 수 있음을 시사했다.

evidence.title: Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of orally administered vitamin K1 for warfarin-associated coagulopathy in Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: CONCLUSION: Low-dose oral vitamin K1 can be effectively administered to Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves taking warfarin to rapidly reduce elevated INR values.
evidence.outcome: PURPOSE: Warfarin-associated coagulopathy commonly occurs in patients undergoing treatment with this anticoagulant. | This trial aimed to determine the efficacy of using low-dose orally administered vitamin K1 to lower international normalized ratio (INR) values into the target range in a cohort of Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves. | Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves who were undergoing warfarin treatment and who had INR values from 4.0 to 10.0 without bleeding were the subjects of this study.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: Low-dose oral vitamin K1 can be effectively administered to Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves taking warfarin to rapidly reduce elevated INR values.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 저용량 경구 비타민K1은 와파린을 복용하는 중국 기계식 심장판막 환자에게 투여해 상승한 INR 수치를 빠르게 낮추는 데 효과적으로 사용할 수 있습니다.

all_evidence.title: Managing Anticoagulation and Dual Antiplatelet Therapy in Patients with Active Bleed or Upcoming Procedure: A Scoping Review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: Emergent anticoagulation reversal treatment is available for both warfarin (i.e., prothrombin complex concentrate, phytonadione) and DOACs (i.e., idarucizumab for dabigatran reversal; andexanet alfa for apixaban and rivaroxaban reversal).
all_evidence.outcome: INTRODUCTION: The aim of this paper is to provide primary care providers and hospitalists with up-to-date guidance surrounding the management of anticoagulation and antiplatelet agents in periprocedural settings and when unexpected bleeding complications arise. | RESULTS: For direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) and vitamin K agonists (VKAs), a patient's risk for clot and procedural risk of bleeding should be assessed. | Generally, patients considered at high risk for venous thromboembolism (VTE) should be bridged, patients at low risk should forgo bridging therapy, and patients in the intermediate range should be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

evidence.title: Phase 1 study of the effect of icosapent ethyl on warfarin pharmacokinetic and anticoagulation parameters.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: IPE 4 g/day did not significantly change the single-dose AUC(0-∞) or C(max) of R- and S-warfarin or the anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin when co-administered as racemic warfarin at 25 mg.
evidence.outcome: EPA, the active metabolite of IPE, is mainly metabolized via β-oxidation, and studies suggest that omega-3 fatty acids such as EPA may have antithrombotic effects. | The objective of this study was to evaluate the effect of IPE on the pharmacokinetic and anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin, a substrate of cytochrome P450 2C9-mediated metabolism. | Primary pharmacokinetic end points were area under the concentration-versus-time curve from zero to infinity (AUC(0-∞)) and maximum plasma concentration (C(max)) for R- and S-warfarin; pharmacodynamic end points were area under the international normalized ratio (INR) effect-time curve after the warfarin dose (AUC(INR)) and maximum INR (INR(max)).
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: IPE 4 g/day did not significantly change the single-dose AUC(0-∞) or C(max) of R- and S-warfarin or the anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin when co-administered as racemic warfarin at 25 mg.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이코사펜트 에틸(IPE) 4 g/day를 라세미체 와파린 25 mg과 병용해도 R·S-와파린의 단회 투여 AUC(0-∞) 또는 Cmax, 그리고 와파린의 항응고 약력학은 유의하게 변하지 않았습니다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase I|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
evidence.population: The objective of this study was to evaluate the effect of IPE on the pharmacokinetic and anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin, a substrate of cytochrome P450 2C9-mediated metabolism. | METHODS: Healthy adults received oral warfarin (25 mg) on day 1, oral IPE (4 g/day) on days 8-35, and co-administration on Day 29. | Primary pharmacokinetic end points were area under the concentration-versus-time curve from zero to infinity (AUC(0-∞)) and maximum plasma concentration (C(max)) for R- and S-warfarin; pharmacodynamic end points were area under the international normalized ratio (INR) effect-time curve after the warfarin dose (AUC(INR)) and maximum INR (INR(max)).

evidence.title: One Milligram Versus Two Milligram Intramuscular Vitamin K to Prevent Late-Onset Hemorrhagic Disease in Young Infants: A Randomized Controlled Trial.

all_evidence.outcome: OBJECTIVE: To compare the efficacy of a standard dose (1 mg) with 2 mg vitamin K administered by intramuscular (IM) route in reducing subclinical late-onset vitamin K deficiency bleeding (VKDB) assessed using serum protein induced by vitamin K absence (PIVKA II) levels. | Neonates delivered to mothers receiving antiepileptics, anti-tuberculous drugs, or warfarin, and those with a family history of bleeding disorder were excluded.

all_evidence.title: Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of orally administered vitamin K1 for warfarin-associated coagulopathy in Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: CONCLUSION: Low-dose oral vitamin K1 can be effectively administered to Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves taking warfarin to rapidly reduce elevated INR values.
all_evidence.outcome: PURPOSE: Warfarin-associated coagulopathy commonly occurs in patients undergoing treatment with this anticoagulant. | This trial aimed to determine the efficacy of using low-dose orally administered vitamin K1 to lower international normalized ratio (INR) values into the target range in a cohort of Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves. | Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves who were undergoing warfarin treatment and who had INR values from 4.0 to 10.0 without bleeding were the subjects of this study.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: Low-dose oral vitamin K1 can be effectively administered to Chinese patients with mechanical heart valves taking warfarin to rapidly reduce elevated INR values.

all_evidence.title: Vitamin K for improved anticoagulation control in patients receiving warfarin.
all_evidence.venue: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_24: AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: Two included studies in this review compared whether the addition of a low dose (150 to 175 mcg) of vitamin K given to participants with a high-variability response to warfarin improved their INR control.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Effective use of warfarin involves keeping the international normalised ratio (INR) within a relatively narrow therapeutic range. | Overcoagulation can lead to an increased risk of excessive bleeding, while undercoagulation can lead to increased clot formation. | OBJECTIVES: To assess the effects of concomitant supplementation of low-dose oral vitamin K for anticoagulation control in patients being initiated on or taking a maintenance dose of warfarin.
all_evidence.key_finding: AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: Two included studies in this review compared whether the addition of a low dose (150 to 175 mcg) of vitamin K given to participants with a high-variability response to warfarin improved their INR control.

all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Meta-Analysis|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review

evidence.title: Arteriovenous fistula outcomes in Malaysia: A systematic review and meta-analysis of maturation, failure and patency rates.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: Intraoperative heparin significantly reduced early thrombosis (RR 0.36; 95% CI, 0.13-0.99), whereas fish oil and aspirin had no measurable benefit.
evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included primary failure (early thrombosis or non-maturation), maturation at ~6 weeks, complications and predictors of outcome. | Intraoperative heparin significantly reduced early thrombosis (RR 0.36; 95% CI, 0.13-0.99), whereas fish oil and aspirin had no measurable benefit. | Complication profiles resembled international reports, dominated by stenosis and thrombosis.

evidence.key_finding_ko: 수술 중 헤파린은 초기 혈전증을 유의하게 줄였지만(RR 0.36; 95% CI, 0.13-0.99), 생선기름과 아스피린은 측정 가능한 이점이 없었습니다.
evidence.population: Intraoperative heparin significantly reduced early thrombosis (RR 0.36; 95% CI, 0.13-0.99), whereas fish oil and aspirin had no measurable benefit.

evidence.title: Traditional chinese medicine injections with activating blood circulation, equivalent effect of anticoagulation or antiplatelet, for acute myocardial infarction: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: The meta-analysis results demonstrated that the combined application of TCMi-ABC, compared with conventional western medicine treatment alone, significantly reduced in-hospital mortality in AMI patients [RR= 0.41, 95% CI (0.29, 0.59), P < 0.05], decreased the incidence of malignant arrhythmia [RR= 0.40, 95% CI (0.26, 0.61), P < 0.05], and increased left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) [MD= 5.53, 95% CI (3.81, 7.26), P < 0.05].
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Traditional Chinese medicine injection for Activating Blood Circulation (TCMi-ABC), which exhibits comparable anticoagulant and antiplatelet effects, is commonly used as an adjuvant treatment for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) in China. | There was no significant difference in the incidence of adverse events between the two groups (P > 0.05). | The GRADE evidence quality classification indicated that the evidence for in-hospital mortality, malignant arrhythmia, and adverse events was of moderate quality, while the evidence for LVEF was of low quality.
evidence.key_finding: The meta-analysis results demonstrated that the combined application of TCMi-ABC, compared with conventional western medicine treatment alone, significantly reduced in-hospital mortality in AMI patients [RR= 0.41, 95% CI (0.29, 0.59), P < 0.05], decreased the incidence of malignant arrhythmia [RR= 0.40, 95% CI (0.26, 0.61), P < 0.05], and increased left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) [MD= 5.53, 95% CI (3.81, 7.26), P < 0.05].
evidence.key_finding_ko: 메타분석 결과 TCMi-ABC 병용은 기존 서양의학 치료 단독과 비교해 AMI 환자의 병원 내 사망률을 유의하게 낮췄고[RR= 0.41, 95% CI (0.29, 0.59), P < 0.05], 악성 부정맥 발생률을 낮췄으며[RR= 0.40, 95% CI (0.26, 0.61), P < 0.05], 좌심실 박출률을 높였습니다(LVEF) [MD= 5.53, 95% CI (3.81, 7.26), P < 0.05].
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Traditional Chinese medicine injection for Activating Blood Circulation (TCMi-ABC), which exhibits comparable anticoagulant and antiplatelet effects, is commonly used as an adjuvant treatment for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) in China.

evidence.title: [Network Meta-analysis of oral Chinese patent medicines in treating type 2 diabetes mellitus complicated with angina pectoris of coronary heart disease].
evidence.venue: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: Current evidence suggests that the patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus complicated with angina pectoris of coronary heart disease could reasonably choose oral Chinese patent medicines on the basis of routine antiplatelet, anticoagulant, hypoglycemic, and antihypertensive therapies, which could reduce the incidence of adverse cardiovascular events, alleviate the symptoms of angina pectoris, and reduce the glucose and lipid metabolism indicators.
evidence.outcome: Shexiang Baoxin Pills + conventional western medicine had the best effect on reducing the incidence of adverse cardiovascular events, and Yixinshu Capsules + conventional western medicine on reducing the frequency and duration of angina pectoris. | Current evidence suggests that the patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus complicated with angina pectoris of coronary heart disease could reasonably choose oral Chinese patent medicines on the basis of routine antiplatelet, anticoagulant, hypoglycemic, and antihypertensive therapies, which could reduce the incidence of adverse cardiovascular events, alleviate the symptoms of angina pectoris, and reduce the glucose and lipid metabolism indicators.
evidence.key_finding: Current evidence suggests that the patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus complicated with angina pectoris of coronary heart disease could reasonably choose oral Chinese patent medicines on the basis of routine antiplatelet, anticoagulant, hypoglycemic, and antihypertensive therapies, which could reduce the incidence of adverse cardiovascular events, alleviate the symptoms of angina pectoris, and reduce the glucose and lipid metabolism indicators.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 현재 근거는 관상동맥질환 협심증을 동반한 제2형 당뇨병 환자가 일상적인 항혈소판, 항응고, 혈당강하, 항고혈압 치료를 바탕으로 경구 중국 특허의약품을 합리적으로 선택할 수 있으며, 이는 심혈관 이상사건 발생률을 낮추고 협심증 증상을 완화하며 포도당 및 지질 대사 지표를 낮출 수 있음을 시사합니다.
evidence.population: Current evidence suggests that the patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus complicated with angina pectoris of coronary heart disease could reasonably choose oral Chinese patent medicines on the basis of routine antiplatelet, anticoagulant, hypoglycemic, and antihypertensive therapies, which could reduce the incidence of adverse cardiovascular events, alleviate the symptoms of angina pectoris, and reduce the glucose and lipid metabolism indicators.

all_evidence.title: Vitamin K for improved anticoagulation control in patients receiving warfarin.
all_evidence.venue: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_24: AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: Two included studies in this review compared whether the addition of a low dose (150 to 175 mcg) of vitamin K given to participants with a high-variability response to warfarin improved their INR control.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Effective use of warfarin involves keeping the international normalised ratio (INR) within a relatively narrow therapeutic range. | Overcoagulation can lead to an increased risk of excessive bleeding, while undercoagulation can lead to increased clot formation. | OBJECTIVES: To assess the effects of concomitant supplementation of low-dose oral vitamin K for anticoagulation control in patients being initiated on or taking a maintenance dose of warfarin.
all_evidence.key_finding: AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: Two included studies in this review compared whether the addition of a low dose (150 to 175 mcg) of vitamin K given to participants with a high-variability response to warfarin improved their INR control.

all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Meta-Analysis|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Effective use of warfarin involves keeping the international normalised ratio (INR) within a relatively narrow therapeutic range. | However, patients respond widely to their dose of warfarin. | Overcoagulation can lead to an increased risk of excessive bleeding, while undercoagulation can lead to increased clot formation.

all_evidence.title: Safety of Vitamin K in mechanical heart valve patients with supratherapeutic INR: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: The current evidence does not support the role of low-dose vitamin K as a trigger of thromboembolism in supratherapeutic INR patients with mechanical heart valves.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Patients who had mechanical heart valves and an international normalized ratio (INR) of >5.0 should be managed by temporary cessation of vitamin K antagonist. | This study aimed to investigate the safety of low-dose vitamin K1 in patients with mechanical heart valves who have supratherapeutic INR. | Studies comparing the safety of low-dose vitamin K1 treatment in patients with placebo or other anticoagulant reversal agents were included.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: The current evidence does not support the role of low-dose vitamin K as a trigger of thromboembolism in supratherapeutic INR patients with mechanical heart valves.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 현재 근거는 INR이 치료범위를 초과한 기계식 심장판막 환자에서 저용량 비타민K가 혈전색전증을 유발한다는 역할을 뒷받침하지 않습니다.

all_evidence.title: Impact of Vitamin K Administration on Elevated International Normalized Ratio in Chronic Liver Disease.
all_evidence.venue: Clinical and applied thrombosis/hemostasis : official journal of the International Academy of Clinical and Applied Thrombosis/Hemostasis
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: The administration of vitamin K in hospitalized patients with CLD resulted in minimal INR change, suggesting this intervention may not have the intended benefit of reducing bleeding risk.
all_evidence.outcome: However, vitamin K is commonly used to treat elevations in international normalized ratio (INR) in these patients with the intended benefit of reducing bleeding risk. | This retrospective, single-center cohort study aimed to evaluate the impact of vitamin K administration on INR in patients with CLD. | The primary outcome was the absolute change in INR from baseline to 24 to 48 h after vitamin K administration.
all_evidence.key_finding: The administration of vitamin K in hospitalized patients with CLD resulted in minimal INR change, suggesting this intervention may not have the intended benefit of reducing bleeding risk.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 만성 간질환 입원 환자에서 비타민 K 투여 후 INR 변화는 미미해, 출혈 위험 감소라는 의도한 이득이 없을 수 있음을 시사했다.

evidence.title: Randomized trial of two maintenance doses of vitamin D in children with chronic kidney disease.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_13: In children with CKD stages 3-5, a dose of vitamin D3 4000 IU daily was effective in achieving or maintaining vitamin D sufficiency.
evidence.outcome: None of the patients developed vitamin D toxicity or hypercalcemia.
evidence.key_finding: In children with CKD stages 3-5, a dose of vitamin D3 4000 IU daily was effective in achieving or maintaining vitamin D sufficiency.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 만성콩팥병 3단계에서 5단계 소아에서 비타민D3 4000 IU를 매일 투여하는 것은 비타민D 충분 상태를 달성하거나 유지하는 데 효과적이었습니다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Correction of nutritional vitamin deficiency is recommended in children with chronic kidney disease (CKD). | METHODS: We conducted a phase III, double-blind, randomized trial of two doses of vitamin D3 in children ≥ 9 years of age with CKD stages 3-5 or kidney transplant recipients. | CONCLUSIONS: In children with CKD, 1000 IU of daily vitamin D3 is unlikely to achieve or maintain a plasma 25(OH)D ≥ 30 ng/mL.

evidence.title: The role of nutritional vitamin D on microinflammation and nutritional status in maintenance hemodialysis patients: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
evidence.outcome: Key outcomes included CRP, serum albumin, TNF-α, IL-1β, immunoreactive Parathyroid Hormone (iPTH), adverse events, hypercalcemia, and hyperphosphatemia. | In terms of safety, the overall incidence of adverse reactions in the nutritional vitamin D group was similar to that in the control group (P = 0.09). | Moreover, no significant differences were found in the incidence of hypercalcemia and hyperphosphatemia between the two groups (P = 0.15, P = 0.32).
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 영양학적 비타민 D 보충은 혈액투석 환자의 미세염증과 영양상태를 개선할 수 있고, 고칼슘혈증이나 고인산혈증 위험을 뚜렷하게 높이지 않으면서 뼈 대사에도 이득이 있을 수 있다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Microinflammation is widespread in Maintenance hemodialysis (MHD) patients. | Nutritional vitamin D deficiency is closely related to chronic kidney disease inflammation, but whether correcting this deficiency can improve microinflammation in the MHD population remains unclear.
